item.title: XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. After a one-time calibration step on a small labeled calibration set of as few as 30 samples, our attack requires only a single query for each target sample. Unlike prior label-only attacks requiring iterative queries or shadow training, our method relies solely on the predicted label and its accompanying explanation. Our evaluation indicates that XposedMIA achieves …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Why Kubernetes Cannot Contain a Full Lazy-Pulling Cache: Two Impossibility Results and a Bounded, Honest Design for Model Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Lazy container-image pulling makes cold starts of autoscaled model-serving fleets on Kubernetes nearly independent of model size, but it moves the model's bytes into a node-level cache that the platform neither bounds nor accounts for. This article establishes, by experiment, two impossibility results for that cache. A monitoring-side remedy cannot catch its failure: a sentinel readiness probe stays green while 272 of 280 files are unreadable. A platform-side remedy cannot contain it: kubelet, given full disk-pressure visibility, frees 0 bytes and evicts 26 bystander pods, because its reclamation actuator is keyed to an accounting that does not know the cache exists. The article then eliminates the failure class inside the component that owns the bytes, with no change to kubelet or the container runtime interface, by two design rules: a byte budget whose pressure signal is keyed to filesystem truth, so that a never-blocking, lossy accounting still enforces a hard bound (held against about 301,000 dropped updates), and pass-through semantics under which a failed cache write never becomes a failed read, with the coupling traced to a single io.MultiWriter. Across six pre-specified cam…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When Does Physics Beat Data? Data-Efficient Traffic State Estimation with Amortized PINNs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Traffic state estimation (TSE) reconstructs traffic density at unmonitored locations from a sparse set of sensors. Data-driven models work well when sensors are dense but degrade sharply as coverage thins. We show that imposing the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards conservation law as a physics-informed prior makes TSE more data-efficient. On four real corridors (NGSIM, I-80, PeMS04, PeMS08), physics-informed estimators generalise to held-out sensors where data-driven models, including classical and deep kriging, overfit the observed ones. On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低精度预训练通常以验证损失评判，但验证损失匹配时，罕见事实的学习效率是否也一致？论文用受控曝光次数的合成传记数据，从零训练模拟 4-bit 矩阵乘法的 transformer，检验低精度格式的真实代价。

方法 对比 NVFP4 与 BF16 在相同验证损失下的罕见事实召回所需曝光次数；进一步用零均值梯度噪声分解量化代价来源，并测试提高学习率能否补偿。

关键数字 NVFP4 需 1.32× 与 1.52× 曝光次数才达到 BF16 的召回（验证损失仅差 0.5% 与 2%）；主读数下曝光代价约 1.2×；BF16 checkpoint 的梯度统计可无拟合排序各格式代价（Spearman 0.96）。

为什么值得看 提示仅看损失曲线会高估低精度预训练，罕见事实习得应作为独立指标纳入评测。

item.title: Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rat…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Accurate prediction of electronic Hamiltonians would enable broad property inference while avoiding the high computational cost of Density Functional Theory (DFT). However, progress toward general-purpose materials foundation models is limited by a data bottleneck: existing Hamiltonian datasets are typically small, lack structural diversity, and often omit essential relativistic physics such as spin--orbit coupling (SOC). We therefore construct UniHam, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset and benchmark suite comprising 100,000+ DFT-computed complex-valued Hermitian Hamiltonians with full SOC, covering 72 elements and a wide range of crystal geometries and symmetries (spanning diverse lattice types and space-group families). Building on UniHam, we benchmark two representative state-of-the-art models under a standardized protocol and introduce complementary evaluation metrics that jointly assess three dimensions: (i) Hamiltonian reconstruction accuracy, (ii) out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization across composition/symmetry shifts, and (iii) the ability to support downstream property prediction from the predicted Hamiltonians. Experiments on UniHam demonstrate that the proposed benchm…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We introduce Rapid Simulation Based Inference (RSBI), a diffusion-based variational approach to likelihood-free Bayesian inference that achieves high sampling efficiency under large prior-to-posterior volumes. RSBI builds on advances in Schrödinger Bridge (SB) diffusion sampling to handle multi-modal posteriors, with an initial likelihood supplied by a distance measure via a differentiable simulator. The key innovation of this initial surrogate likelihood is that it gives a highly efficient proposal distribution, replacing sequential rounds of other methods with an efficient one-shot proposal. Subsequent refinement then transports the proposal to the true posterior as specified by the simulator and the original prior. The SB sampler is warm-started from the proposal, and its energy is corrected by a neural likelihood ratio that is learned only where the proposal places mass. As a variational method, RSBI does not suffer from prior leakage commonly observed in standard sequential posterior estimation methods. To improve mode coverage we optionally utilize the well-tempered meta-dynamics framework, which also encourages exploration of the prior volume. We observe strong performance o…

item.title: Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 一个模型接管另一模型的对话通常须重读全部历史；KV cache 翻译把源 cache 映射成目标自身格式，使目标从完整上下文继续而无需重读——对 GQA 已可行，但开源前沿模型如今缓存压缩潜变量（MLA）、稀疏注意力索引器 key 与定长线性注意力状态。

方法 复现 KV-Lingo 于 GQA 对，再为每类对象给出捕获/注入位置与达到原生质量的机制：MLA 潜变量用逐 token 线性映射翻译；循环状态用闭式校正复制或用目标自身循环重放合成；研究 16–48B 规模两个混合对的双向翻译（Kimi-VL-A3B ↔ Kimi-Linear-48B、Qwen3.5-27B ↔ Qwen3.8-27B）加稀疏注意力目标。

关键数字 从源层 0 MLA 潜变量解码 token id 使 needle 召回从 0.09 升至 2–32K 的 0.99、64K 的 0.83–1.00（最长训练 prompt 的 8 倍）；混合全 MLA 方向每个任务指标都在原生质量配对置信区间内；64K token 时首 token 时间比重读短 18.7x 与 46.8x。

为什么值得看 把 KV 翻译从 GQA 推进到 MLA/线性注意力/稀疏索引器混合架构，为模型间无缝交接对话提供完整配方。

item.title: To SIMD or Not to SIMD: Comparing RVV vs. CGRA SoCs for Non-Linear Functions in AI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 非线性函数是 LLM 中的重要操作类别，但芯片厂商一直用传统向量/标量单元处理，其性能跟不上几乎所有厂商都配备的矩阵乘单元（MMU）；FPGA/CGRA 等可重构单元缺乏与 MMU 搭配的传统单元的系统比较。

方法 构建两个 SoC：RVV 向量处理器 SoC 与延迟不敏感（elastic）CGRA SoC，均配 MMU 与单核 CPU 驱动；为常见前馈网络提出映射，系统对比两类方案。

关键数字 CGRA 在简单逐点非线性（如 SiLU）激活阶段相对 RVV 最高快 7.12x 时钟周期；RVV 在复杂非线性（如 softmax）上相对 CGRA 最高快 9.8x；在完整前馈块上对应最大值分别为 3.16x 与 4.24x。

为什么值得看 首次系统对比 RVV 与 CGRA 处理非线性函数的差异，结论「简单函数 CGRA、复杂函数 SIMD」对 AI SoC 单元选型有直接参考。

item.title: TSFFormer: A Frequency-Domain Spike Transformer for Green Human Activity Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enable pervasive Human Activity Recognition (HAR), but traditional Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) suffer from an "arithmetic-latency deadlock" due to dense floating-point MAC operations. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer ultra-low power, existing ones face spatial blind spots, rigid neurons, and gradient degradation. To address these, we propose TSFFormer, a purely spiking Fourier Transformer for Green HAR. It introduces two key innovations: (1) a MultiHeadFourier attention that performs frequency-domain global mixing, reducing complexity from \(O(V^2)\) to \(O(V\log V)\), eliminating spatial blind spots, and saving \(\sim\)50% GPU memory; and (2) a dual-compartment Temporal Spiking LIF (TSLIFNode) that utilizes dynamic thresholds to adapt to non-stationary rhythms and mitigate gradient degradation. Extensive experiments on 8 public IMU benchmarks demonstrate that TSFFormer surpasses state-of-the-art SNNs and even the classic DeepConvLSTM, achieving a \(\sim\)3\(\times\) faster training speed with an energy footprint of 0.1 pJ. Ablation studies confirm the synergistic effect of our modules, providing a highly accurate, ultra-low-powe…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised…

item.title: Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at this https URL.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Sequence-to-function models such as AlphaGenome and Borzoi read up to a megabase of DNA and score a genetic variant by comparing their predictions for the reference and alternate sequences. Insertions and deletions (indels) are costly to score, because an indel usually shifts the unchanged DNA after it onto a different pooling grid, which prevents direct reuse of the reference's encoder activations. The AlphaGenome Atlas scored more than 100 million indels with three full model passes each, although the DNA after an indel matches the reference shifted by the indel's length. We present ShiftCache, an exact reuse system that encodes each shifted reference once and shares it among all variants scored in the same window with the same shift. ShiftCache copies every encoder output a variant can reuse and recomputes the rest in batched tiles. On held-out AlphaGenome windows shared by many indels, in strict fp32 on one A6000, ShiftCache is 3.5 to 6.5$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution and 1.6 to 2.7$\times$ faster than our adaptation of layer-by-layer reuse to indels. It is 3.5 to 4.1$\times$ faster than dense reimplementations of two published analyses with Borzoi and AlphaG…

item.title: Shaping Useful Noise: Energy Distributions Predict Visual Pretraining Quality
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Synthetic data can scale visual pretraining, but current selection criteria only partially explain which datasets train strong representations. We propose using the energy profile of a dataset--the distribution of log-probability levels it occupies under a normalised real-image density model--as an audit and curation principle for synthetic data. To operationalise this view, we introduce Energy-Level Distribution Distance (ELD), which compares real and synthetic energy distributions. Real images span sparse high-likelihood scenes and dense low-likelihood textures, so useful synthetic data should cover this energy range rather than collapse to likely but low-variation samples. Across diverse synthetic datasets, ELD exposes mismatches missed by FID and predicts pretraining performance beyond FID, LPIPS variation, and feature-space recall, including across CNN and ViT self-supervised settings. We then use ELD to resample and mix synthetic sources, matching the real-image energy histogram while preserving diversity and improving downstream transfer.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Scaling Taxonomy-Free Image Labeling with Generative AI: A Multimodal
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs. We present Generative Labeling On Clusters (GLOC) as a solution to provide highly scalable, cost-effective, low latenc…

item.title: Scale-Invariant Empirical-Bayes Laplace Approximation for ReLU Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

ReLU networks are well-known to have continuous scale symmetries; infinitely many reparameterized weight vectors that represent the same function. Dinh et al. (2017) have shown that, by reparameterizing, the geometry of the loss landscape (e.g., curvature) of these networks can be changed arbitrarily without affecting the underlying function. Thus, any quantity that depends on the network's geometry should be defined with care. In this paper, we show that the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace's approximation is not well-defined for ReLU networks, mainly due to Hessian dependence in computing the marginal likelihood, which is not invariant under ReLU scale symmetries. Thus, we can get different prior precisions, posterior covariances, and predictive uncertainties for a network having identical predictions under ReLU scaling. We define family of prior precision fields indexed by $\gamma$ and introduce $\gamma$-canonicalization, which first converts the network to its canonical representation by balancing the ratio of incoming to outgoing weights, and then fits the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace to the canonical representation. This procedure is equivalent to transporting the isotropic Gauss…

item.title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Large materials design spaces often contain rare high-performing configurations that are difficult to identify through trial-and-error exploration or purely representative machine-learning (ML) sampling. In this work, we present FruBO, a flexible Bayesian Optimization framework for accelerating the discovery of optimal configurations in computationally demanding materials design problems. As a case study, we investigate multilayer Moiré patterns generated by the superposition of six rotated hexagonal lattices, where the objective is to identify the rotational conformation that maximizes pore-size uniformity, quantified using the Jain fairness index. The resulting benchmark contains 600,000 unique configurations and exhibits a highly skewed objective distribution, making the global optimum difficult to locate by random sampling. We compare random exploration, Gaussian Process-based Bayesian Optimization, and Bayesian Optimization using a lightweight CatBoost surrogate with committee-based uncertainty estimation. Random sampling identifies the global optimum only after 533,012 evaluations, requiring approximately 31 hours, while Gaussian Process-based BO becomes impractical due to GP…

item.title: Resetting-based designated information distribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

For a network of $n$ nodes under random gossip dynamics, we show that by introducing the additional resetting mechanism (with rate $β$) to a designated subset of $r$ nodes, the expected sum of all node values is asymptotically equal to $\tfrac{n}{r}$ times the sum of the initial values of the $r$ designated nodes, in the small-$β$ and long-time limit. We also analyze the convergence speed to this asymptotic state and provide an approximate high-probability confidence interval for the expected sum at finite time $t$ and finite $β$. Operationally, we propose a protocol that distributes the initial node values over the designated subset evenly (up to a prescribed precision), by appropriately turning on and off the resetting dynamics. Our work not only offers insights into classical problems such as distributed computing and network control, but also serves as a potential foundation for designing quantum algorithms that prepare desired states in quantum networks using only local operations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Release Sooner, Expose Less: Offloading MoE Dispatch in NCCL-EP under Dual-Batch Overlap
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 双微批重叠（DBO）把 MoE 通信藏到另一微批计算之后，但只有 dispatch 发送释放 GPU 后才生效——dispatch 发送占用 GPU 的时间因此暴露，而释放后的网络推进可被隐藏。

方法 在 NCCL-EP 上评估三种针对暴露通信时间的研究配置：GPI（GPU 构造 GPU-Friendly Descriptors 并提交到 NIC 可访问内存传输）、GPI-MC（单个 GFD 描述 MoE token 扇出）、GDAKI Free Flow（把发送推进移到主机线程）。

关键数字 GB300 NVL72 上三种方法在多数参数扫描工作点降低 dispatch-send 时间；send 与 receive 间插入 32–512 微秒计算可隐藏延迟推进；分离式 vLLM serving 中相对 NCCL-EP 默认 GDAKI 中位 TPOT 降 15–25%，相对 DeepEP v1 降 16–42%。

为什么值得看 聚焦 DBO 下被忽视的 dispatch 暴露时间，给出三种可落地的 offload 方案与量化收益。

item.title: RecoGEM: A Serving System for Production-Scale Generative Recommendation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Generative recommendation (GR) is moving industrial recommender systems (RecSys) from scoring candidate items to autoregressively generating item identifiers. This shift promises higher recommendation quality, but makes serving substantially harder: each request executes a short sequence of dependent decoding steps that explore a large item space and select promising candidates on the latency-critical path. GR not only creates structural mismatches with conventional RecSys pipelines, but also challenges the architectural and optimization assumptions of LLM serving stacks, making direct adoption of existing systems difficult. We present RecoGEM, our production GR serving system. RecoGEM uses a runtime--engine decoupling architecture to move GR-specific serving responsibilities, such as candidate-state transitions and live artifact updates, to a dedicated runtime. Its execution engine exploits GR's short token sequences, large candidate populations, and predictable step shapes to optimize self-attention, candidate selection, and execution planning. RecoGEM has been deployed for over nine months across our production lines, serving applications with hundreds of millions of users and s…

item.title: Pairwise distortion distribution for compression and quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Choosing the latent dimension is a critical challenge in data compression, where conventional hyperparameter optimization is costly and ad hoc. Intrinsic dimension provides a good alternative, which connects information-theoretic notions such as Renyi information dimension (RID) to rate-distortion dimension and random codebook compression. In this work, we introduce the pairwise distortion distribution (PDD) and its asymptotic limit, pairwise dimension (PD), which generalize the correlation integral to general distortion measures. We show that PD bounds RID, and PDD provides a lower bound for random codebook quantization performance, which can guide a practical use for compression, quantization, and dimensionality reduction applications.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OverlapAdvisor: Modeling and Adapting Computation-Communication Overlap for Distributed MoE Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 专家并行（EP）的 MoE 推理依赖 All-to-All 通信，计算-通信重叠策略至关重要，但没有任何策略普遍最优——103 个生产配置、不同输入长度与四类硬件上，最快策略随模型形状、EP 度、输入长度与硬件变化。

方法 提出 OverlapAdvisor：用两种粒度建模重叠阶段以刻画计算-通信依赖，构建统一性能模型（计入峰值计算/内存/通信性能的偏差），支持两个 serving 引擎内的启动时、配置感知策略选择。

关键数字 四个 MoE 模型（30B–235B）对三个基线：内核级平均 1.16x、最高 1.59x 加速，预测 MAPE 3.3%–15.9%；SGLang/vLLM 端到端吞吐最高提升 31.7%；对 DeepEP-v1 与 FlashMoE 的中位加速分别为 1.10x 与 1.22x。

为什么值得看 用数据证明「无普遍最优」并给出配置感知选择模型，直接提升生产 MoE serving 的吞吐。

item.title: Optimal Proximity Black Hole Search with Programmable Matter
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The concept of programmable matter (PM) envisions objects composed of tiny, mobile particles capable of self-arrangement, which allows them to change shape, color, and move. We initiate the study of the Black Hole Search problem within the context of PM. The problem involves a dangerous and unnoticeable location, the black hole, that, without a trace, destroys any particle visiting it. In our setting, particles move inside a convex area embedded in a triangular grid, where one vertex is a black hole. The objective is for the particles to identify a restricted set of vertices containing the black hole while ensuring that at least one particle survives. We present an algorithm utilizing three particles capable of assuming just two colors to identify the dangerous region where the black hole resides. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this algorithm is Pareto optimal in terms of number of particles and number of colors required, and asymptotically optimal in terms of number of epochs, where an epoch refers to the minimal time window within which each particle completed an activation cycle at least once.

item.title: Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. item.title: One-Shot Federated Graph Learning via High-Fidelity Proxies and Transferability-Guided Collaboration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

One-shot Federated Graph Learning (OFGL) has emerged as a communication-efficient paradigm for federated graph learning under strict bandwidth constraints, compressing collaboration into a single transmission round. Nevertheless, this extreme setting suffers from a fundamental Single-Transmission Bottleneck, which limits both the quality and utility of exchanged knowledge. First, while existing methods attempt to distill private graphs into shareable proxies, their aggressive one-shot compression inherently triggers a fidelity crisis. This compression distorts local graph topology and semantics across clients, leading to externalized knowledge underexpression. Second, although the server aggregates these proxies to update global models, current integration schemes suffer from transferability agnosticism. The server cannot reliably identify cross-client collaboration potential, thus resulting in integrated knowledge underutilization. To tackle these dual challenges, we propose FedHFT, an effective One-Shot Personalized Federated Graph Learning (OPFGL) framework that addresses this bottleneck from two perspectives, namely High-Fidelity Knowledge Externalization and Transferability-Wa…

item.title: NearFormer: Linear-Size Sparse Attention via Randomized Near Neighbors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 图 transformer 能捕捉长程交互，但二次方注意力成本限制其在大图上的应用。

方法 提出 NearFormer：全局注意力被限制在随机近邻（NN）图上——用高效随机化构造把每个节点连接到由标签无关特征或谱几何定义的更广邻域中的少数近邻；固定保留预算 k 下注意力支撑规模为线性 O(|E|+nk)；NN 图经桶内搜索构建一次后固定，边用作稀疏全局注意力支撑（可选学习注意力偏置），原图保留用于局部消息传递。

关键数字 长程图基准与合成结构任务上，相对局部消息传递、密集与稀疏注意力呈现有利的准确率-可扩展性权衡（摘要未给具体量化数字）。

为什么值得看 用随机近邻把图 transformer 注意力降到线性规模，兼顾长程建模与可扩展性。

item.title: Mitigating SM-Level Load Imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting on GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic, real-time rendering on commodity GPUs and is increasingly adopted in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators. However, existing optimizations rely on algorithmic changes that often require retraining, or on specialized accelerators that lack flexibility across evolving 3DGS variants. In this paper, we identify a fundamental inefficiency in GPU-based 3DGS rendering: severe SM-level load imbalance caused by uneven workloads across screen tiles. This imbalance creates a long execution tail, leaving most SMs idle while a few process computationally intensive tiles, particularly in large-scale urban scenes. To address this, we present a software-defined GPU scheduling approach that mitigates the execution tail. Our approach uses a persistent kernel to schedule heavy tiles first and selectively chunks outlier tiles across multiple CTAs. A lightweight per-frame policy determines when and how much to chunk using tile statistics already available in the rendering pipeline. Our approach requires neither retraining nor specialized hardware and can be applied orthogonally to existing optimizations across diverse 3DGS varian…

item.title: MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying machine learning models in high stakes scientific applications, yet methods that flag OOD inputs without retraining the model have been validated almost exclusively on image classification. We introduce MOOD (Materials Out-of-Distribution Detection), a benchmark for evaluating whether these post-hoc OOD detectors transfer to graph neural networks (GNNs) on materials property prediction. MOOD evaluates 15 post-hoc detectors and 2 supervised diagnostic probes across 4 GNN architectures, 5 MatBench tasks, and 15 physically motivated compositional and structural shifts, yielding 264 evaluation settings and over 13,000 AUROC measurements across three encoder training seeds. Our evaluation reveals three key findings. First, current post-hoc detectors perform near chance; all 15 detectors achieve an AUROC around 0.5. Second, detector failures decompose into two regimes: method bottlenecks and encoder bottlenecks. Method bottlenecks arise when supervised probes can separate in-distribution (ID) from OOD samples but unsupervised detectors fail, meaning that the embeddings contain OOD signal that current detectors do not extract.…

item.title: Learning to Select Sparse Linear Solvers with Convolutional Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We investigate convolutional-neural-network (CNN) based automatic solver selection for sparse linear systems, a problem of practical importance where solver performance varies dramatically with matrix sparsity structure. A CNN is trained to regress log timing ratios between candidate solvers using spy plot images of matrix nonzero structure as input, achieving strong prediction accuracy on both held-out SuiteSparse matrices and real-world matrices from high-performance simulation codes.

item.title: Late but Valuable: Why Deadlines Change the Measured Value of LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) increasingly plan and run experiments in automated laboratories. These experiments keep running while the model reasons and run on schedules with hard deadlines. If an LLM-generated answer arrives late, the system executes a safe fallback action instead, such as rejecting a sample. This creates a systems problem that standard serving metrics do not capture. An answer that matches the fallback adds no value, and answers that differ from the fallback may require more reasoning time. Reporting answer quality and latency separately can therefore overstate the value of reasoning. We test this on synthetic sample decisions, where the best choice is known exactly and a runtime enforces the deadline. We compare one LLM's fast mode, which answers directly, with its thinking mode, which reasons first. In a prespecified replay of 1,200 new decisions, thinking answers that missed a deadline were worth about five times as much as on-time ones. Multiplying the on-time rate by the mean answer value predicted about twice the value that thinking delivered. This prediction overstated thinking's advantage over fast mode by 0.0241 per decision, and by 0.0191 in a repeat on…

item.title: LBSNet: Lightweight Brain State Modeling via Learnable Spectral Prototypes for EEG-Based Fatigue Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

EEG-based fatigue detection requires modeling spectral information across bands and its temporal variation. Recent methods combine multi-band modeling with adaptive temporal processing, yet how spectral structure across bands should influence the contribution of each temporal interval remains insufficiently explored. We propose LBSNet, a lightweight network that uses prototype-based brain-state modeling to link local spectral structure with temporal aggregation. LBSNet extracts compact multi-band features through band-specific temporal convolution, shared spatial projections, and cross-band recalibration. Within each window, relative spectral activity is encoded as a normalized descriptor and softly matched to learnable spectral prototypes. Prototype assignments and learned prototype importance jointly determine temporal weights for power aggregation, allowing the spectral pattern of each window to guide its contribution to the prediction. Subject-independent experiments on SEED-VIG and SADT show that LBSNet outperforms seven baselines while maintaining low computational cost. item.title: KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm…

item.title: KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Nonseparable costs and coupled constraints in distributed online convex optimization often arise when system performance and operational constraints depend on the joint configuration of all agents and cannot be decomposed into individual contributions. Such nonseparability leads to fully distributed decision-making with challenging partial local information, where each agent evaluates its local primal-dual update using estimated global information via a local belief of the joint action and the shared Lagrange multiplier to be exchanged with neighbors. While the belief consensus established by prior works ensures no-regret learning, exchanging beliefs comprising full-dimensional primal and dual states at every round imposes a communication overhead that scales with both the joint decision dimension and the network size. Existing event-triggered schemes typically activate communication according to state variation or consensus error. Under nonseparable coupling, however, errors of equal magnitude can produce markedly different perturbations after passing through the KKT operator. item.title: K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Self-recurrence represents an important component for temporal processing in neural networks, both artificial and biological, where it appears naturally in the form of leaky integration. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies of the gradient, an efficient and effective method of online training is still lacking. Here we propose K-prop, a novel online learning method for leaky neural networks. It dramatically reduces the computational and memory cost of real time recurrent learning (RTRL) by propagating kernel gains. K-prop also outperforms existing RTRL approximations and achieves performance comparable to backpropagation through time in sequence learning, classification, and reinforcement learning tasks. We further analyze how its sole approximation affects gradient quality and identify conditions under which K-prop remains accurate and effective.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and…

item.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Privacy-Enhanced Computing Through Register Renaming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Privacy-Enhanced Computing (PEC) is a mechanism to hide program secrets from the outside world without paying the cost of fully-homomorphic encryption. Previous work has developed hardware mechanisms to achieve this goal but they require a dedicated processor enclave where all computations are done, requiring duplicate ALU resources and limiting the performance of PEC-utilizing applications due to not being able to access the full compute resources of the processor (e.g., multiple execution units and vector units), or not being able to execute PEC instructions in parallel and out-of-order. In this work, we introduce HPS-PEC (Hidden in Plain Sight PEC), a novel method of utilizing existing infrastructure in the CPU to achieve PEC with minor modifications to the architecture. We show that, across 25 VIP-Bench benchmarks and with a 7-cycle QARMA-64 cipher, HPS-PEC runs encrypted code at 3.41x the execution time of unprotected native code (geometric mean), of which 1.03x is the cost of data-oblivious code itself, and is 1.26x faster than a Sequestered Encryption (SE) unit while utilizing under a third of its dedicated area. item.title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Federated Unsupervised Visual Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) is a promising research paradigm that enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without data sharing. To handle unlabeled data in local clients, existing unsupervised FL research has primarily focused on tasks like clustering and self-supervised representation learning, leaving the critical problem of unsupervised visual recognition largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce FedUR, the first framework designed for unsupervised recognition by leveraging the zero-shot capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP. Specifically, FedUR addresses data heterogeneity through a pseudo-labeling mechanism with a class-aware data selection strategy. This strategy first estimates a global pseudo-label distribution, then allocates pseudo-labeled data to clients accordingly. To handle the uncertainty of conventional positive pseudo-labels, FedUR further incorporates class weights and a negative pseudo-labeling strategy. Furthermore, FedUR proposes a personalized prompt aggregation protocol where general visual prompts are aggregated on the server, and personalized text prompts encoding local knowledge are retained on clients.…

item.title: FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuning a deployed language model on one task after another can change behaviour that should stay fixed, such as earlier skills, general chat or refusals. Today, such forgetting is found only after training, on the benchmarks someone chose to run. This work bounds, before training, how often its outputs change on chosen prompt distributions. FireGate places each task's update, such as a new LoRA, behind a gate, which is a classifier on the model's frozen lower layers that decides for each prompt whether the update is used. Where no gate fires, the model computes exactly what the old one computes. As a result, on any prompt distribution, every bounded behaviour score changes by at most the gates' firing rate there over a whole task stream. Calibrating each gate on unlabeled prompts of what must not change fixes that rate before training, with a PAC guarantee, whatever weights training produces. Forgetting is thus bounded by the gate's false-alarm rate, and its price is the gate's power: no update, gated or not, that changes as few protected outputs can change new-task outputs more often than the best test of that level tells new-task prompts from protected ones. On reinforcement…

item.title: Exploiting Native Hardware Heterogeneity: Custom GPSIMD Operators for Accelerating Emerging LLM Memory on AWS Trainium
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 新兴内存模块（如 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 Engram）混合不规则整数工作（64-bit n-gram 哈希、稀疏表查找）与稠密计算（GEMM 与 gate）；GPU-FPGA 系统可拆分到不同设备加速 5.9x，但 AWS Trainium 的 GPSIMD 引擎只能通过固定内置指令调用，官方自定义算子工具链不支持 Trainium 2/3 且不能与 NKI 同用。

方法 构建工具链：为 GPSIMD 核编译 C++ 自定义算子，注入到 Trainium 3 上 NKI 内核编译出的 NEFF 中，在当前软件栈内扩展 GPSIMD 可定制性。

关键数字 相对手调 NKI 基线：两个 GPSIMD 算子在 decode 阶段把 n-gram 哈希加速 1.79x、表检索最高 4.95x、整个 Engram 计算最高 1.14x。

为什么值得看 在 Trainium 上绕过官方工具链限制、把自定义算子注入 NEFF 的方法，对利用该平台原生异构算力有直接参考价值。

item.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Evidence or Marginal? What Moment-Vector Propagation Computes in Polynomial Density Neurons
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

When a neuron's input is lost, or known through a belief $q$, what should it output? For a neuron storing a joint polynomial density $N$ with input density $D$, two formulas compete. $p_\mathrm{CD}=E_q[N]/E_q[D]$ costs one matrix-vector product; Hierarchical Correlation Reconstruction introduces it as a constant-denominator approximation to $p_\mathrm{EU}=E_q[N/D]$. For a density model both are exact answers to different questions: $p_\mathrm{CD}$ is Bayesian updating with the belief as virtual evidence; $p_\mathrm{EU}$ installs the belief as a new marginal (Jeffrey's rule). With a missing input $p_\mathrm{CD}$ returns the model's conditional; $p_\mathrm{EU}$ generally does not. This post hoc reading is proved, and illustrated outside the pair family up to $k=8$ inputs; it has no pre-registered test, only one exploratory real-data pilot. Post hoc, closed forms fall within a factor 2 of all 112 measured gaps, and negative density begins near input correlation $1/k$. In a pre-registered synthetic study (up to 32 inputs), 5 of 15 hypotheses are supported, 2 inconclusive and 8 not supported, including all three on transfer beyond equicorrelated Gaussians. item.title: Efficient Online Submodular Maximization with Bandit Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We study online monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint with bandit feedback. On each round, the learner selects at most $k$ elements from a ground set of size $n$ and observes only the value of the selected set. We develop an efficient algorithm achieving $O\!\left(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)}\right)$ expected $(1-1/e)$-regret over $T$ rounds. To our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm with $\sqrt{T}$ dependence on the horizon for arbitrary monotone submodular functions in the bandit setting. Our approach uses randomized sampling and a carefully constructed potential to reduce online submodular maximization to online linear optimization over the probability simplex.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Do Time-Series Foundation Models Forecast Index-Futures Returns? A Preregistered Evaluation of Models, Metrics, and Input Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We ask whether the apparent forecasting skill of frozen time-series foundation models (TSFMs) on intraday index-futures returns is incremental skill. In a pre-registered evaluation on E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) and E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures, a common panel of five zero-shot models (Chronos-Bolt, Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Moirai 2.0 and TiRex), plus separate experiments with Kronos, is compared with a no-change forecast at 5-120 minutes, using native prices, log returns, volatility-standardised returns and a volume clock as inputs. On a blind set opened once, 0 of 160 model-representation-horizon-market cells beat no-change, and a Hansen SPA test gives p = 1.000 on both markets; a later retrospective hold-out, scored as a descriptive check, gives 0 of 120. Input representations change forecast magnitude but not accuracy, and a transformation-aware ridge regression does as well. Several standard measures nevertheless suggest skill. Price-level correlation exceeds 0.9996, but no-change scores higher. item.title: DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics …

item.title: DeFSM: Robust and Efficient Decentralization of Federated Submodular Maximization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Submodular maximization seeks a small subset best representing a large dataset. In its federated setting, the server is a single point of failure and some clients may be Byzantine. Removing the server raises a trilemma of decentraliza- tion, efficiency, and security. We propose DeFSM, a Byzantine-robust and communication-efficient architecture that replaces the server with a lightweight smart contract and a pool of independent, consensus-free agents. Its aggregation rule, SafeGM, builds on two notions from combinatorial geometry: Tukey depth and safe points (the points lying in the convex hull of the good points wherever the bad points are). SafeGM makes the robust decision on 2D Gaussian random projections, which the contract can compute efficiently, and lifts it back as a convex combination of actual updates. Since lifting loses information, it uses the projected geometric median only when its depth certifies it, and otherwise a Tukey median. The share of bad updates is then bounded only by a count: how many there are, not what they contain. We prove, and confirm empirically, that this bound controls the solution quality. On CIFAR10 and PathMNIST, with up to 30% Byzantine clients…

item.title: Correct First, Fast Second: What a Local 7B Code Model Can and Cannot Do for GPU Kernel Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

We study how much the interaction strategy around a fixed, locally hosted 7B-parameter code model (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct) affects its ability to replace PyTorch operators with custom CUDA kernels. On 30 KernelBench tasks (levels 1-3, first 10 each, evaluated on a V100), we compare four regimes of increasing structure: zero-shot prompting, profiling-guided prompting, iterative refinement on execution feedback, and a multi-agent loop (analysis, retrieval, generation, evaluation, feedback triage) in which the same model fills four roles around a non-LLM evaluator. Three findings stand out. (1) Correctness, not speed, is the binding constraint: even correct generated kernels average 0.97-0.99x the speed of eager PyTorch, because a 7B model cannot out-write cuBLAS/cuDNN on dense GEMM and convolution; the only real wins are fused memory-bound epilogues. (2) The best strategy depends on difficulty: profiling-guided prompting is strongest overall (43% correct, 27% faster than baseline), but the agent loop is the only method that solves any level-2 fusion problem (3/10 vs. 0/10 for all others). (3) Naive agentic scaffolding is actively harmful: our first agent scored 3% correct, below z…

item.title: Controlled Binary Assignment Flows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

item.title: Contention Resolution with a Fast-but-Fickle Channel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

The contention-resolution problem studies how $n$ devices share a communication channel without centralized coordination. Classical models typically assume a single continuously available channel and focus on minimizing total completion time. However, modern wireless systems increasingly rely on shared spectrum, where access may be abruptly revoked by incumbent users. Motivated by this setting, we study contention resolution with two channels: a reliable slow channel and a faster channel that can be intermittently disabled by unpredictable eviction periods. Moving a batch of packets from the slow channel to the fast channel incurs a unit cost, while evictions from the fast channel impose a larger per-packet penalty. Our goal is to achieve asymptotically optimal latency while minimizing switching overhead relative to an optimal offline algorithm that knows the eviction schedule. We present Randomized Adaptive Channel Exploitation (RACE), a randomized algorithm that exploits the fast channel when available while maintaining progress on the slow channel during disruptions. item.title: CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Stellarators are fusion devices that use externally generated, three-dimensional magnetic fields to confine hot plasma and offer a promising route to commercial fusion. Their electromagnetic coils pose a challenging design problem: they must reproduce the target magnetic field while satisfying engineering constraints and remaining practical and cost-effective to manufacture. Finding suitable geometries is a highly nonlinear inverse problem that generally has neither a closed-form nor a unique solution. This problem lies at the heart of stellarator design. We introduce CoilStellaration, a dataset and benchmark for learning the mapping between coil geometries from target plasma magnetic fields and engineering requirements. The dataset contains 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting plasma equilibria from ConStellaration, with sampled engineering requirements and achieved geometric and magnetic-field metrics. It spans multiple coil counts and field-period numbers, supporting studies of both specialized and shared models across configurations. item.title: CARE-PO: Controllable Tool-Call Efficiency for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

External tool calls are a major running cost of an LLM agent, while its training objectives align almost exclusively with task completion. In a step-level diagnosis of Qwen3.5 trajectories at two model sizes on GAIA, a long-horizon tool-use benchmark, we find that most contain removable calls, at a similar rate at both sizes. Some methods add an efficiency reward to the objective to reduce the call count, but introduce problems of their own: the anchor they price calls against is computed from the policy's own rollouts (e.g., the group's shortest correct rollout) and so moves with the policy; training can drift toward a collapsed policy that issues no tool call at all, a degeneracy seen in published reports and in our 27B baseline; and a training run delivers a single operating point, so the user cannot trade efficiency against capability. We present CARE-PO (Controllable Anchored Relative Efficiency Policy Optimization) to mitigate these problems. item.title: Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Unlike the brain, artificial neural networks (ANNs) suffer from "catastrophic forgetting": complete overwriting of solutions when re-training on new functions ("concept shift") or on a disjoint domain of the current function ("domain shift"). ANNs require each batch of data to be roughly representative of the complete distribution, a typically expensive and impractical requirement. In this paper, we introduce Functional Task Networks (FTNs), a method of continual learning and knowledge transfer modeled after several properties of the mammalian neocortex. FTN is formulated as a distributed, stochastic mixture of experts in which a sparse, binary routing mask is computed at inference time using a small support sample of input-output pairs. Per-batch reconfiguration of the router during training, together with mask-overlap-filtered replay, shapes a basis of overlapping, partially trained subnetworks. Unrelated tasks route through mostly separate assemblies, related tasks overlap on shared components. On block-sequentially trained continual learning and knowledge transfer tasks FTN retains solutions nearly as well as disjoint-mask isolation and attains the lowest pre-update head-start …

item.title: Attention Is Only as Good as Its Witnesses: When Higher-Order Layers Help, and When They Do Not
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Transformers stop learning graph search as graphs grow, and learn the card game SET only after many distinct questions, although attention can represent both. We read these failures, and the uneven record of higher-order attention, from what a layer sums over: each layer we study computes the partition function of a family of witnesses and reads it at a temperature. Two laws follow. The depth law is a known result of logic, which we state for these layers: L layers over two-step walks reach exactly 2^L - 1 steps, just as a logical statement with L nested clauses of the form "there is a vertex such that" sees exactly that far. We build a construction that reaches this far, checked in Lean, and, when vertices carry no names, no such network reaches further. The size law is the cost of reading at a temperature, which logic does not have: existence is read correctly at every size, in the worst case, if and only if inverse temperature times margin is at least the logarithm of the number of candidates. Layers built on these laws, and on two principles that we test, learn where Transformers fail. One propagator layer trained on 49-vertex graphs answers every question at every search depth…

item.title: AscSpMM: Efficient SpMM on Ascend NPUs via Pipelined Vector-Cube Collaboration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 NPU 矩阵引擎与软件管理片上内存偏好稠密计算，而 SpMM（图分析、稀疏神经网络、科学计算关键内核）需要索引驱动操作数选择、间接寻址、分散访存与负载均衡，与 NPU 固定形状/连续布局冲突；GPU Tensor Core 方法无法直接迁移到向量/矩阵引擎解耦的 NPU。

方法 提出 AscSpMM：用参数化 Vector-CSR 表示把不规则操作数准备与规则矩阵计算分离——向量引擎解码索引、收集重排稠密操作数，Cube 引擎做矩阵乘累加；双槽环形缓冲实现依赖感知异步流水，操作数复用与运行时自适应分块减少跨引擎停顿。

关键数字 Ascend 910B3 上相对 GEMM 几何平均加速 2.36x、相对既有 SpMM 实现 19.92x、相对 A100 上 cuSPARSE 5.82x；矩阵输入存储与峰值 HBM 占用平均降 48.24% 与 22.98%，与专用 GPU Tensor Core SpMM 内核竞争力相当。

为什么值得看 NPU 上 SpMM 的向量-矩阵引擎协同设计范式，含异步流水与访存优化细节，代码已开源。

item.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Stability in Network Intrusion Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Quantum kernel methods have been proposed for network intrusion detection, yet their performance limitations are often attributed to noise in current quantum hardware. This study evaluates that assumption through a controlled analysis of Pegasos-QSVC on the NSL-KDD and ToN-IoT datasets. We perform 56 quantum experiments using one exact noiseless statevector backend and three noise-simulated superconducting backends while keeping preprocessing, PCA features, data splits, and classical baselines identical. XGBoost achieves accuracies of 98.94% on NSL-KDD and 99.41% on ToN-IoT, compared with 91.80% and 82.98% for Pegasos-QSVC. The quantum model also exhibits substantially greater seed-dependent variability. Eight runs collapse into degenerate classifiers, including four recall-collapse cases and four trivial-positive classifiers. Notably, two failures occur on the noiseless backend, demonstrating that hardware noise is not a necessary condition for classi-fier collapse. Kernel Gram matrix analysis further reveals low effective rank and severe ill-conditioning even in the absence of noise, indicating intrinsic fragility in the learned quantum representation. item.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Motivated by reinforcement learning subject to communication constraints, we study a policy evaluation problem with linear function approximation over a rate-limited channel. In our setup, an agent interacting with an unknown environment (modeled as a Markov Decision Process) transmits quantized estimates of a temporal-difference (TD) learning update direction to a server over a finite-capacity channel. Our goal is to investigate to what extent one can preserve the statistical convergence rates achievable when the channel has infinite capacity. item.title: Adapting Multi-Stage Distributed Real-Time Systems Design to Vehicular Edge Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) aims to support computation-intensive applications in intelligent transportation systems while meeting stringent latency requirements. When processed remotely, applications require access to different resource types in a specific sequence, forming a multi-stage processing pipeline. This structure closely resembles multi-stage distributed applications executing across heterogeneous resources, making established multi-stage distributed real-time scheduling techniques well suited for modeling VEC systems. The resulting model accommodates diverse resource configurations and access patterns. Building on this model, we propose a joint mapping and scheduling approach that accounts for vehicle mobility and real-time constraints. The proposed heuristic extends optimal priority assignment for multi-stage systems to the VEC setting, to construct feasible schedules while minimizing local-device energy consumption and ensuring that offloaded jobs meet their deadlines. Extensive simulations show that the proposed approach consistently outperforms both a baseline based on the same delay-composition framework and a deadline decomposition-based approach.

item.title: Accelerating Direct Sparse Solvers with Graph Computing Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Solving large sparse linear systems by Gaussian elimination is a challenging computational task due to the introduction of non-zero elements, or fill-in. Practitioners use heuristics such as the nested dissection reordering algorithm to try to reduce fill-in. In practice, reordering codes do not achieve the same parallel scaling as factorization, nor can they exploit AVX instructions or GPUs. Thus, reordering can be the primary runtime bottleneck in large-scale computer-aided engineering applications. We consider the use of a novel accelerator, the UpDown system, to accelerate the METIS multilevel nested dissection reordering algorithm. The UpDown system is designed for a broad class of graph computing and irregular algorithms. We report results for small-scale UpDown systems that will be available commercially in 2027, using validated simulation and FPGA emulation platforms. Our findings indicate that small UpDown systems can speed up METIS by two-orders of magnitude versus a single CPU. Compared to ParMETIS on hundreds of MPI ranks, we anticipate the same small UpDown systems offer speedups of 4 - 7, providing the potential to significantly speed finite element simulations

item.title: A Geometric Invariant of Attention Predicts Head Specialization from Weights Alone
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-09　分类：论文PDF

Transformers are built with continuous symmetries in the attention mechanism. We derive $\rho$, a scalar invariant that measures each head's capacity to couple to rotary positional encodings. This framework allows us to analyze heads without forward passes, opening a new research direction into data-independent analysis of modern LLMs. Empirically, we find that $\rho$ predicts induction heads, the most-studied circuit type in mechanistic interpretability, with Spearman correlation between $-0.55$ and $-0.74$ across four bias-free RoPE models spanning $135$M to $7$B parameters. As a preliminary proof of concept, we use $\rho$ to apply YaRN to only the top-50% positional heads, which degrades perplexity less than uniform application. Code is available at this https URL.

item.title: ZarrFM: A Canonical Tensor Storage Architecture for EEG Foundation-Model Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF

Statistical models for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) increasingly require large, heterogeneous EEG corpora, yet existing datasets vary in sampling rates, channel layouts, window lengths, and storage formats, creating substantial preprocessing and I/O overhead. We propose ZarrFM, an execution-oriented representation that complements BIDS by storing a corpus as a single Zarr v3 hierarchy with indexed metadata, canonical channel spaces, explicit masks, hash-stable subject splits, verified event tables, and block-aligned sharding. On real PhysioNet recordings and synthetic corpora, we compare ZarrFM with EDF, FIF, NPY, HDF5, and Parquet. Across 200 recordings, its two-level index reduces metadata queries from 601 requests to 14. Preserving native signal codes reduces storage from 42.4 MB/hour in EDF to 22.7 MB/hour, while block-aligned sampling reaches 3,131 windows/s, up to 11 times faster than Parquet. Reads remain bit-identical across independent Zarr implementations, and concurrent failure-injected appends recover without data loss. These results show that ZarrFM can provide a compact, interoperable, and execution-efficient storage layer for large-scale EEG pretraining.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Where Should a Gate Look? Input vs. State Gating in Diagonal State Space Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF

Modern state-space models owe much of their computational efficiency to their linear, often diagonal, dynamics. Classical recurrent neural networks instead allow nonlinear state-to-state interactions, which can be beneficial when memory updates need to depend on the past context. In this paper, we ask whether state feedback through a simple gate regulating memory updates can enhance the expressivity of diagonal state-space models. To investigate this question, we compare gates that depend on the current input, the recurrent state, or both. We establish a strict expressivity separation: for scalar models, state gating solves induction-head tasks for arbitrary vocabulary size and sequence length, whereas input gating fails on a finite instance under standard stability assumptions on the state transition matrix. Experiments show that state gating retains its advantage on induction-head tasks in higher-dimensional models, whereas input gating performs better on selective copying tasks. Together, our results show that even a simple, diagonal form of state-feedback gating can unlock capabilities unavailable to input-controlled models, while input and state gating offer complementary stre…

item.title: When gene summaries reveal the answers: Gene Ontology circularity in gene embedding benchmarks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF

A gene summary can contain the very annotations used to evaluate an embedding of its text. The Alliance of Genome Resources converts Gene Ontology (GO) annotations into sentences, which NCBI Gene displays and GenePT includes in its input. These summaries covered 6,172 of 19,256 human protein-coding genes (32.1%), including 58% of genes with one to ten linked publications. We embedded the same corpus with and without the generated summaries and refitted a function-prediction probe on each version. Among genes with one to ten publications, removal reduced the reported per-gene area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) by 0.078 with a linear probe (95% bootstrap interval 0.072-0.084) and by 0.033 with a multilayer perceptron. These estimates use a historical GO scorer that mishandled ties. The original predictions are unavailable for rescoring. A simple TF-IDF encoder also benefited from the summaries, as did models evaluated only on experimental annotations. Replacing generated summaries with UniProt function descriptions recovered much of the lost performance despite little verbatim overlap. UniProt also curates many of the evaluation labels. item.title: When Is High-Bandwidth Flash Cost-Effective for LLM Inference?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 高带宽闪存（HBF）能否让 LLM 推理比加 GPU 更便宜？把权重放在比 SSD 更靠近 GPU 处可减少容量所需 GPU 数，但只有在满足服务目标且成本可回收时才合理。

方法 用公开组件数据模拟：九个密集与 MoE 模型、五个负载、两个 GPU 平台、1–100 GPU 规模，评估固定需求下最小 GPU 数与固定 GPU 数下的吞吐。

关键数字 固定需求下 HBF 在 468 组比较的 98 组中降低满足服务目标所需最小 GPU 数，多数为暂停与短会话场景，63 组在「每 HBF 栈半块 GPU 价格」下仍划算；单短聊用户场景 HBF 让 DeepSeek V3、Kimi K2 等大 MoE 在单张 RTX 4090 满足宽松服务目标（传统 serving 做不到）；100 张 RTX 4090 规模下级联 HBF 把三个大 MoE 离线吞吐提升 16.4–26.5x。

为什么值得看 用系统化模拟回答「什么时候 HBF 值」：省钱与提吞吐出现在不同场景，决策依据清晰。

item.title: When Calibration Data Matter in Sub-4-Bit Language Model Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低位训练后量化大幅降低 LLM 内存但可能严重损害下游任务精度；校准通常用通用文本，但任务知情数据何时能恢复精度、哪些量化器受益，此前不明确。

方法 提出 FragCal-DC：用「在 2-bit 扫描中全精度精度保留低」的任务族训练文档补充通用文本；用 2–4 bit 扫描定位功能区间，四次种子校准对比，在六个密集模型（1.7B–8B）与十个任务上评估六种数据相关方法。

关键数字 2-bit 下 SignRound V2 跨六模型十任务平均精度比通用文本校准高 1.83pp，GPTQ 与 OmniQuant 在 2-bit 也提升；恢复集中在校准包含的任务族，错误答案指定保留约 90% 平均精度增益；70B 规模 GPTQ 与 SignRound V2 的 2-bit 同样受益。

为什么值得看 给出任务知情校准作为低位量化保精度的设计原则，并澄清哪些方法在哪些位宽真正受益。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF

Collaborative multi-objective optimization allows independent problem solvers to contribute their solutions to a shared problem. However, their validity cannot be reliably verified in open settings if the parties are reluctant to disclose their solutions. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel zk-NSGA-II protocol for verifiable, privacy-preserving and collaborative multi-objective optimization on blockchain. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that executes Non-Dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) on the RISC Zero Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machine (zkVM) where evolutionary generations are certified by succinct proofs that are verified on-chain. Problem solvers maintain their own independent populations as the set of solutions in the decision space and their corresponding objective vectors in the objective space. They contribute to a global on-chain Pareto front by aggregating their local off-chain Pareto fronts according to the rule of non-domination which admits a contribution if it is non-dominated with respect to the existing contributions in the global front. item.title: UTOPI: Efficient Egocentric Long-Video Understanding in AR via User-Guided Token Pre-Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF

As long-video understanding gains increasing attention, augmented reality (AR) devices are emerging as a compelling deployment platform. However, egocentric videos exhibit significant temporal redundancy, imposing substantial memory and computational burdens on resource-constrained AR hardware. To address this challenge, we introduce UTOPI, a plug-and-play pre-compression module designed specifically for egocentric long videos on AR platforms. First, we leverage user motion signals to estimate inter-frame overlap and propose a viewpoint-shift-invariant pruning algorithm. Second, we exploit eye-tracking sensors to identify user fixations, enabling the separation of attended foreground content from background and its preferential retention via a fine-tuned neural network-based adjustment mechanism. Across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, UTOPI achieves up to 95% compression while preserving performance. Code and project page are available at this https URL.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Race Is Decided Early! A Kernel Law Predicts Lock-In in Majority-Vote Test-Time RL
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF

Test-time reinforcement learning with majority-vote rewards trains a language model on unlabeled questions by rewarding the samples that agree with its most frequent answer. During training, each question locks into one answer, on hard questions often a wrong one, but which answer it locks into is known only after training. In this paper, we show that this outcome is decided early, in a short race driven by sampling noise between the answers that are close at the start, and we derive the probability of each outcome. With a separate logit for each answer, the runner-up wins with a normal tail probability of the initial gap, scaled by an explicit noise constant. In a network, however, the answer logits depend on shared parameters, and through the kernel of these parameters the updates of the trailing answers also change the gap of the two leaders. This spillover shifts the boundary between the starts won by each leader, and a closed form computes the shifted probability from a kernel probe and the start logits. item.title: TEAM: Topology-Aware, Semantic-Sensitive, General Transformer for Multimodal-Attributed Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-08　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) organize heterogeneous data in graphs whose nodes are characterized by modalities such as text and images rather than traditional unimodal attributes. However, many representative MAG methods organize propagation around node-level states and topology-defined neighborhoods, which can obscure fine-grained modality contributions: a bounded neighborhood may contain semantically weak evidence, while compatible context need not be confined to it. To address both limitations, we propose TEAM, a modality-centric framework that constructs and encodes graph context with node-modality tokens rather than treating each node as a single interaction unit. Concretely, TEAM unfolds the local topology into a Modality Encoding Tree and performs tree-anchored semantic evidence acquisition, organizing local structural context while expanding the accessible evidence space outside the constructed local Tree. We further introduce the Modality-Source Context Transformer (MSCT), which encodes the selected node-modality tokens and coordinates interactions among modality-source groups.
