item.title: Hydro-Dataset: A Multi-Modal Open-Source Pipeline for Nordic Hydrological Research and Foundation Model Benchmarking
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Despite world-class snow monitoring by the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI) and Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI), no station-anchored, multi-parameter snow benchmark dataset exists for the Nordic boreal domain. We present Hydro-Dataset v1.1, a reproducible open-source pipeline that harmonizes 582 SMHI meteorological observation stations across nine hydrological winters (2015/16-2023/24) into a CF-1.9 NetCDF product with 1.8~million annotated station-days. Six derived snow parameters, such as Snow Water Equivalent (SWE), snow phenology, melt rates, degree-day melt factor, rain-on-snow flags, and freeze-thaw cycles, supply benchmark-ready labels for hydrological foundation model training. ERA5-Land cross-validation (Pearson R=0.78, bias=-262mm) confirms observation-anchored SWE provides a more reliable benchmark than reanalysis for machine learning training.

item.title: HexIt: Learning Hexahedral Block Decomposition with Expert Iteration on Combinatorial Maps
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Decomposing a polyhedral solid into a few well-shaped hexahedral blocks is a long-standing open problem in mesh generation. We cast it as a sequential decision problem on a 3-dimensional generalised map: an agent splits edges, faces and volumes with three insert operations until every cell is a hexahedron and the mesh passes a quality threshold, and a policy that convolves over the map's involutions chooses each insert. A successful decomposition takes over a hundred decisions, and a uniformly random policy never finds one. We clone a policy from constructed decompositions and improve it by expert iteration. On held-out chamfered solids that share no boundary topology with the cloning data, the final policy solves an expected $94.4\%$ in $20$ samples, and expert iteration raises the best-of-20 solve rate on large chamfered solids from $0.203$ to $0.355$. At matched compute, PPO, GRPO and VinePPO updates all make the cloned policy worse.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: GradReason: LLMs as Meta-Learners that Replace Training Epochs with Training-Data-Free Weight Updates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Standard training recipes make a fixed number of passes over the training data, even when an epoch mostly adds mini-batch noise. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that reads the weight and gradient history of a run can replace some of these epochs with updates that compute no gradient and read no training image. In GradReason, an LLM agent is called every ten epochs. In a restricted sandbox, it analyses recent weight snapshots, epoch-mean gradients, and validation metrics, then submits a Python program that computes new weights and a plan marking each of the next ten epochs as data or virtual. A virtual epoch is kept only if it passes a forward-only check on 5,000 held-out validation images. In 120 runs on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with three architectures, Claude Opus 5.5 used 32.8% fewer data epochs than the 80-epoch recipe at 0.31 percentage points lower test accuracy (95% CI -0.72 to +0.09; 0.94 points on ResNet-18), on the recipe's own frontier of data against accuracy. Unprompted, Opus averaged recent weight snapshots in every run. This choice produced the savings: a fixed rule with the same acceptance check but extrapolations from prior work saved 5.4% of the data e…

item.title: Firepool: Brokering Warm GPU Capacity for Agentic and RL Workloads at LinkedIn
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 AI agent 与 RL 训练器运行成千上万个短小的隔离 GPU 任务（工具调用、验证器、rollout），任务秒级完成但启动 GPU pod 需 20–35 秒甚至数分钟；热 pod 既要消除等待又不能浪费 GPU 或泄漏状态。

方法 Firepool（LinkedIn 的沙箱与执行经纪）：按硬件画像用共享基础镜像构建可互换 pod，任务开始时才绑定代码与依赖；仅把 pod 复用于上一个调用者、以分片 GPU 共享部署零 VRAM 待机 pod、用队列驱动预算限制热池 GPU 容量。

关键数字 峰值期 94.7% 的 3,206 个 pod 请求由热/待机容量服务；固定时长任务对比新 pod 每任务，agent 与 RL 循环分别快 13x 与 10.8x；热复用把 p90 启动延迟从 59.1s 降至 3.5s；待机晋升把切换等待从 51s 缩至 0.94s。

为什么值得看 生产级 warm-pool 经纪系统设计：可互换性、安全复用与容量成本三者如何同时满足。

item.title: Finite Time Analysis of Risk-Sensitive RL via Noisy Power Iteration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Estimating the principal eigenpair of a positive operator from stochastic evaluations gives rise to a noisy form of normalized power iteration: each step applies a sampled operator estimate and then renormalizes. We establish finite-time stochastic-approximation guarantees for this procedure, working in Hilbert's projective metric, which is well-suited to the multiplicative geometry of Perron--Frobenius eigenproblems. Our main application is risk-sensitive average-cost reinforcement learning (RL) with exponential utility. In this setting the Bellman equations are multiplicative, and value functions are characterized by nonlinear eigenvalue problems rather than additive fixed points. We cast both policy evaluation and control in this framework, obtaining risk-sensitive TD- and Q-learning algorithms that learn from a single Markovian trajectory. Under explicit positivity, mixing, and linear function approximation assumptions, we prove finite-time bounds on the recovered eigenvector and eigenvalue with $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ sample complexity up to problem-dependent constants. The results cover both tabular and linear function approximation regimes, and through the duality between…

item.title: FedSGN: Federated Sparse Grassmann Newton Learning for IoT Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Anomaly detection plays a critical role in securing the Internet of things (IoT). Although existing federated principal component analysis (PCA) methods can learn the subspace of normal samples without sharing raw data, they often suffer from feature redundancy that may degrade detection performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel and effective federated sparse Grassmann Newton (FedSGN) learning method for IoT anomaly detection. Technically, our FedSGN leverages the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm constraint on the global projection matrix to eliminate redundancy and introduces an orthogonality penalty to preserve the intrinsic structure. Moreover, we develop an augmented Lagrangian solver integrated with a semismooth Newton scheme to enable parallel client updates and Grassmann projection for robustness. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable overall detection performance while reducing communication overhead. The source code is publicly available at this https URL

Although existing federated principal component analysis (PCA) methods can learn the subspace of normal samples without sharing raw data, they often suffer from feature redundancy that may degrade detection performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel and effective federated sparse Grassmann Newton (FedSGN) learning method for IoT anomaly detection. Technically, our FedSGN leverages the $\ell_{2,0}$-norm constraint on the global projection matrix to eliminate redundancy and introduces an orthogonality penalty to preserve the intrinsic structure. Moreover, we develop an augmented Lagrangian solver integrated with a semismooth Newton scheme to enable parallel client updates and Grassmann projection for robustness. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable overall detection performance while reducing communication overhead. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as the preeminent paradigm for high-fidelity generative modeling across various modalities, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the severe computational overhead of iterative sampling. While recent feature-caching methods mitigate this latency through feature reuse or forecasting based on integer-order operators, they remain limited in adapting to the non-stationary and highly curved dynamics of DiT latent trajectories. In this work, we reveal that DiT feature evolution exhibits anomalous diffusion characteristics and a certain degree of spatiotemporal heterogeneity, rendering static, integer-order forecasting operators inadequate and prone to error accumulation. To address this, we propose Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation (FADE), a unified framework for training-free diffusion transformers acceleration. FADE models DiT feature evolution via anomalous diffusion and employs a Mittag--Leffler fractional operator to better adapt to high-curvature and non-linear latent trajectories of DiTs. item.title: EEGFaceSem: An EEG Benchmark with Paired Generative Latents for Semantic Visual Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used to measure brain activity for brain-computer interface applications for its non-invasive nature and high temporal resolution. However, progress in modeling the neural responses to visual semantics has been limited by a reliance on fixed image collections that lack the fine-grained control needed to isolate fine-grained changes in visual features and their relation to perception. In this work, we present EEGFaceSem, a large-scale dataset pairing high-quality EEG with photorealistic face images synthesized from a generative model. We provide the generative latent vector for each stimulus, enabling research into the continuous mapping between a visual latent space and neural representations. Each participant's brain responses were recorded while they attended to specific semantic features (e.g., smiling, hair color) in a rapid serial visual presentation paradigm. The dataset contains EEG signals from 30 participants, totaling 67,200 time-locked EEG recordings. item.title: Dynamic State Estimation from Sparse PMUs via Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

This paper proposes a physics-informed graph neural operator for power system dynamic state estimation. From a sparse, intermittent measurement window at a few generator buses, the operator estimates the rotor-angle and speed trajectories of all machines, unmeasured ones included, in one forward pass. A graph-attention encoder processes the measurements, and the swing equations are imposed as a hard constraint or as a soft one with a learned correction that absorbs model errors. It is trained on simulated measurements, without state labels. With several phasor measurement units, masked training hides one from the input but keeps it in the loss. On four transmission systems, simulations show that the operator is the most accurate estimator that neither optimizes per scenario nor uses state labels, except on the smallest system at large model errors, where tuned Kalman smoothers are better. Networks trained on simulated states are more accurate on the two smallest systems but not on the 118-bus system, where the operator is faster and more accurate than hard-constrained moving-horizon estimation. Under model errors, it matches or outperforms an optimization-based benchmark at a fract…

item.title: Detent: Batch-Invariant LLM Serving and RL Rollouts at Near-Stock Speed
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 可复现评测、可验证推理与 on-policy RL 要求 LLM 引擎对同一请求无论与谁同批都给出相同输出比特；引擎的确定性模式靠每算子保留一个保守内核来消除选择，但付出延迟代价。

方法 Detent 把内核选择表达为引擎可执行的程序，找出该程序中必须固定的最少批相关值，并在部署前按负载调优——多数快速内核本身即批无关，只需修少数几个选择读取的值。

关键数字 Llama-3.1-70B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 vLLM/SGLang 多 GPU 部署下完全批无关；按负载调优后每输出 token 延迟为 Stock 的 1.04–1.17x（确定性模式为 1.67–10.3x）；训练器在 Detent 内核上逐 bit 复现 rollout logprob，为 Stock 的 1.03x 耗时；BF16 GRPO 在 Stock 崩溃时保持稳定。

为什么值得看 用最小固定集换取批不变性，摆脱确定性模式的高延迟惩罚，直接服务于可复现 RL 训练。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

In offline reinforcement learning, diffusion models fill two roles with complementary strengths. Typically guided by a critic, a diffusion policy is value-aware and favors high-return, behavior-supported actions, but it is short-sighted: it never lays out the states it intends to visit. A diffusion planner is far-sighted, synthesizing such a long-horizon trajectory, but it is only behavior-driven at execution, realizing each planned transition using only offline this http URL is strong exactly where the other is weak. We introduce DPDP to bring them together at the planner's execution step, where a planned transition becomes an action. Reading the planner's inverse-dynamics executor as a posterior over actions: the environment's transition likelihood relates an action to the planned next state, while the behavioral prior determines its weight under the offline data. Replacing this prior with a value-optimized diffusion policy preserves the planned transition likelihood and favors valuable actions that can serve the plan. item.title: DICOMPUTE: An Economic and Privacy-Aware Framework for Distributed Artificial Intelligence Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

The prevailing design of large-scale artificial intelligence inference concentrates accelerators, model weights, and request processing in centralized computing facilities. Centralization offers important benefits in accelerator utilization, high-bandwidth interconnects, operational control, and serving efficiency. Yet centralized infrastructure is not always the least-cost or most governance-compatible choice for every inference workload. This paper develops a research framework for DICOMPUTE, a heterogeneous distributed inference architecture in which policy-constrained scheduling can allocate suitable requests across privately controlled, regional, and independently operated computing resources. We derive a full-cost comparison that accounts for capital amortization, energy, network transfer, orchestration, utilization, failures, and trust-related expenses; characterize conditions under which distributed inference can outperform centralized alternatives; and specify a privacy model separating data residency, transport confidentiality, execution confidentiality, and verifiable accounting. item.title: Crustify: Repository-Level Generation of Safe Rust Bindings with LLM Agents and Coverage-Guided Testing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Wrapping C code in a safe Rust interface lets Rust applications use it without writing unsafe code, until the code itself is migrated to Rust. Such bindings are tedious and error-prone to write, however: their internals use unsafe code that the Rust compiler does not check, so a single mistake can introduce undefined behavior (UB), and they have so far been written mostly by hand. We present Crustify, an agentic co-translator that generates safe Rust bindings for repository-level C libraries. Crustify schedules a target's types and symbols into dependency-ordered waves of independent batches that agents bind concurrently. Its agents derive the ownership and lifecycle contract of every pointer and type they wrap, check each binding with coverage-guided equivalence and UB tests under sanitizers and Miri, and review every wave. They build on three tools that we contribute: (a) ffibox, Rust primitives for C/Rust interop that mirror Box, Arc, and Vec for C objects without ever forming a reference to memory that C may alias; (b) Wavefront, a neuro-symbolic static analyzer that orders a target's items by their dependencies, including those that casts and type-erased pointers hide; and (c)…

item.title: Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏注意力加速长上下文解码，但现有方法是开环的：内核选定子集后没有任何信号表明注意力质量是否保留，也没有失败恢复路径。

方法 提出 CVSA（Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention）：利用被选 token 上的 softmax 质量占比（coverage）与每步输出误差的精确代数等式，把 coverage 同时用作接受判据与恢复插值权重，形成免训练、闭环的「验证-修正」解码循环，无需采样、草稿模型或投机解码设施。

关键数字 质量随阈值扫描仅波动 0.14 分；LongBench 7B/70B 上距密集注意力仅 1.13 分（70B 统计上持平），RULER 仅损 0.8 分；128K 上下文下中位解码步加速 6.21x。

为什么值得看 用内核内已存在的 coverage 信号把稀疏注意力从开环变成闭环，方法简洁且训练无关。

item.title: CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 1-bit KV cache 压缩误差大，如何把量化器校准与选择性高精度存储结合以降低重建误差。

方法 提出 CALFA-KV：离线联合拟合 key 中心、径向归一化参数与 K/V 向量码本以匹配冻结模型的投影注意力输出，并用参考 next-token 交叉熵损失的平方梯度估计逐通道 Fisher 型敏感度；在线用敏感度加权各 KV 状态的重建误差，在每层每 KV 头预算下保留高分状态为高精度 anchor。

关键数字 每层每 KV 头 56 个额外 FP16 anchor 时，CALFA-KV (d8b8) 在三个模型的七个基准平均分上超过所有 1-bit 基线；d8b10 名义索引率 1.25 bit/通道，与 BF16 差距收窄至 0.90–2.01 分。

为什么值得看 把校准与 Fisher 敏感度 anchor 结合进 1-bit KV 压缩，并给出 anchor 选择相对最优的 excess risk 理论界。

item.title: Bit-level Perceptron Prediction for Indirect Branches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Modern software uses indirect branches for various purposes including, but not limited to, virtual method dispatch and implementation of switch statements. Because an indirect branch's target address cannot be determined prior to execution, high-performance processors depend on highly-accurate indirect branch prediction techniques to mitigate control hazards. This paper proposes a new indirect branch prediction scheme that predicts target addresses at the bit level. Using a series of perceptron-based predictors, our predictor predicts individual branch target address bits based on correlations within branch history. Our evaluations show this new branch target predictor is competitive with state-of-the-art branch target predictors at an equivalent hardware budget. For instance, over a set of workloads including SPEC and mobile applications, our predictor achieves a misprediction rate of 0.183 mispredictions per 1000 instructions, compared with 0.193 for the state-of-the-art ITTAGE predictor and 0.29 for a VPC-based indirect predictor.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Our evaluations show this new branch target predictor is competitive with state-of-the-art branch target predictors at an equivalent hardware budget. For instance, over a set of workloads including SPEC and mobile applications, our predictor achieves a misprediction rate of 0.183 mispredictions per 1000 instructions, compared with 0.193 for the state-of-the-art ITTAGE predictor and 0.29 for a VPC-based indirect predictor.

item.title: Bias, Measurement Error, and Double-Dipping: When Can GNN Convolutions Help Brain Connectome Prediction?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are an important tool for fMRI prediction, where empirical functional connectivity matrices serve both as features and for graph construction. However, recent studies and our own experiments show that these methods often fail to outperform simpler graph-agnostic baselines. We propose a statistical explanation for this failure by formulating connectome prediction as an errors-in-variables (EIV) problem: the true connectome is latent, while the observed covariance matrix is a noisy finite-time-series estimate. In a linear asymptotic setting, we decompose the effect of graph convolution into three mechanisms: smoothing-induced bias and variance reduction, graph estimation error, and a double-dipping effect arising when the same noisy matrix determines both graph and features. Under a latent community model adapted to neuroscience, we identify a narrow favorable regime, set by the brain community structure, the predictive signal, the graph construction and the recording length, in which message passing can improve prediction. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Recent generations of high bandwidth memory (HBM), such as HBM4, allow the base die of the memory stack to be manufactured using a logic process that can accommodate more complex controller functions next to the DRAM. We present the first systematic quantitative study of function-level controller placement between the host and the HBM4 base die on a silicon interposer. We divide the controller into its main functions and evaluate four placements, from a complete host controller to a complete base die controller, with intermediate placements that move maintenance or scheduling to the base die. We extend Ramulator 2 with HBM4 timing and maintenance, model a die-to-die (D2D) link with timing checks at the DRAM interface, and compose area, energy, and temperature from synthesized controller blocks, modeled storage, and interface data. A provisioned D2D link preserves per-stack bandwidth and adds about twice its one-way delay to unloaded latency. Maintenance moves to the base die with no bandwidth cost and frees host command slots, and the freed share grows with stack height. item.title: Bayesian Low-Rank Posteriors for Scalable Membership Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether a sample was used during the training of a target model. Strong MIAs rely on reference (or shadow) models to estimate target-conditional score distributions, but training such ensembles is computationally expensive for modern large-scale Vision--Language Models (VLMs). In this work, we propose a scalable alternative that replaces explicit reference-model training with a Bayesian approximation over low-rank adaptation parameters. Specifically, we model uncertainty only within the LoRA subspace and construct a posterior from a single training run, from which we sample a diverse set of \emph{virtual reference models}. We instantiate this approach using Stochastic Weight Averaging Gaussian (SWAG), enabling efficient approximation of target-conditional score distributions at a fraction of the cost of conventional shadow-model ensembles. We evaluate the resulting attack on three downstream-adapted VLMs across two privacy-sensitive visual question answering tasks, namely Document VQA and Medical VQA. item.title: BRAT: Bounded Residual-Aligned Training for Stable Multi-Pass LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning for large language model post-training often reuses each batch of sampled rollouts for several gradient passes to amortize the cost of generation. Under such multi-pass reuse, existing objectives fail in different ways: unclipped updates collapse as the policy drifts away from the sampling policy, adding a negative baseline avoids collapse but reinforces every sampled response, and PPO-style ratio clipping cuts off gradients abruptly. We first ask why reuse is fragile. Measuring how well an update estimated from a small rollout group aligns with the KL-regularized target on held-out rollouts of the same prompts, we find that this alignment drops by nearly an order of magnitude from in-sample to held-out rollouts across three base models, suggesting that repeated passes largely overfit the sampled group. Motivated by this finding, we propose Bounded Residual-Aligned Training (BRAT), motivated by a proximal update toward a bounded reweighting of the sampling policy. BRAT assigns each token a gradient weight that decreases linearly with its probability ratio and vanishes at a trust-region boundary, and normalizes group-centered rewards by their maximum magnitude…

We propose AutoC2V, a C++-to-Verilog generation framework driven by real synthesis feedback that enables large language models (LLMs) to directly generate RTL with improved quality of results (QoR) from synthesizable C++ kernels. We construct training data from real synthesis results, including synthesizable C++ source code, the corresponding Verilog RTL, QoR metrics, and optimization objectives. item.title: Augur: An Online Learning-based Hardware Data Prefetcher using Reservoir Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Machine-learning-based hardware prefetchers can learn complex access patterns, but practical deployment demands online adaptation, low-latency inference, and modest hardware cost. We present Augur, a hardware delta prefetcher based on next-generation reservoir computing (NGRC) that meets all three requirements. Augur formulates delta prediction as a history-based regression problem. It constructs a fixed-size reservoir from hashed delta features over a short context window and predicts the next delta using a single dot product. The model is updated online via one-step SGD and requires no offline pre-training, no workload-specific tuning, and no floating-point arithmetic. A key technical insight makes this practical: replacing the integer multiplications traditionally used to generate nonlinear reservoir features with bitwise AND operations removes all feature-generation multipliers while preserving the joint context encoded in hash-derived features. Because Augur regresses a continuous delta rather than classifying into a fixed action set, it can predict any delta in [-64, 63]. Augur pairs the reservoir with a simple Markov-based delta predictor for simple delta patterns and employ…

item.title: AbductionBench: Benchmarking Abductive Reasoning in Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

Abductive reasoning is the inference of plausible explanations for observed evidence. Evaluating this capability requires more than a single task: a system may need to generate an explanation, discriminate among competing hypotheses, revise its hypotheses as evidence arrives, or decide what evidence to seek next. Yet these capabilities are typically evaluated through isolated benchmarks with different task formulations and scoring procedures, so claims that a model is ``good at abduction'' may reflect only a narrow aspect of this capability. We introduce AbductionBench, a unified framework whose taxonomy characterizes abductive tasks. We instantiate this framework on 27 datasets spanning ten domains and evaluate eight LLMs from four model families evaluated on single-choice selection tasks. Beyond harmonizing heterogeneous tasks, AbductionBench separates final-answer evaluation from analysis of the observable reasoning traces and interaction histories produced alongside those answers. We analyze written traces as observable model outputs rather than faithful representations of internal computation, characterizing evidence use, hypothesis comparison, uncertainty, contradiction handl…

Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has driven substantial improvements across a wide range of tasks, but the cost of acquiring preference labels remains the dominant bottleneck in the alignment pipeline. While many recent alignment methods improve sample efficiency through active exploration over candidate responses, they typically query the oracle uniformly across contexts, even for contexts where the learned reward estimates are already reliable enough to provide synthetic labels. item.title: A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-07　分类：论文PDF

We develop a variational and geometric theory based on statistical physics for the joint evolution of Transformer attention and token representations at fixed model parameters. To this end, we introduce a free energy for the attention and model the evolution of the attention weights by its Fisher--Rao gradient flow. At fixed token representations, we prove that the softmax matrix is the unique free-energy minimiser and that every positive attention trajectory converges to it. For prescribed time-dependent representations, we show that the attention dynamics becomes linear after a change to logit variables. This result yields tracking bounds relative to the instantaneous softmax and sufficient conditions for attention to converge to a fixed matrix. Hamiltonian dynamics for the representations and their momenta are then coupled to the attention relaxation driven by the same energy. This coupling results in an energy-dissipation law. We also develop two alternative Hamiltonians incorporating the attention value map. We prove global well-posedness of the attention flow and all three coupled systems.

item.title: fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for brain-computer interfaces and cognitive state decoding, but progress in machine learning for fNIRS has been limited by small, isolated datasets and inconsistent evaluation protocols. We introduce fNIRSAtlas, the largest open benchmark for fNIRS classification to date, comprising 23 classification tasks from 19 public data collections, spanning diverse experimental paradigms, including motor execution, motor imagery, mental arithmetic, working memory, and emotion recognition. fNIRSAtlas provides a fully automated pipeline from raw data to evaluation and defines standardized benchmark tasks for both cross-subject and within-subject classification, ensuring reproducible comparison of methods. We evaluate a variety of baseline models from fNIRS and related neuroimaging and time-series machine learning literature on the benchmark. Our results demonstrate that performance varies substantially across tasks and that methods validated on limited data -- especially deep learning approaches -- often fail to generalize beyond their original evaluation. fNIRSAtlas serves as an extensible, open, and reproducible benchmark …

item.title: What Matters for LLM Persona Simulation: Signal Form in Cold-Start E-Commerce Advertising
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Estimating advertising performance in cold-start settings is challenging because historical logs are unavailable before launch. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential alternative by simulating persona-conditioned user responses, but it remains unclear which design choices actually drive LLM-based persona simulation. Using real Google Ads e-commerce campaign data across five demographic segments, we identify three signal-form dimensions that affect simulation quality: (i) a demographic anchor without noisy rich attributes, (ii) a relative qualitative banner-blindness signal rather than quantitative anchors, and (iii) prompt phrasing. On this campaign, our method attains an MAE of 24.9 and a MAPE of 26.1%, a 51.3% lower MAE than the best tested non-LLM baseline and 77.3% lower than an LLM configuration using explicit CTR anchors. Systematic ablations show that minimal demographic descriptions achieve lower mean error than richer persona configurations, while relative qualitative cues substantially outperform the tested quantitative anchors. We additionally compare these configurations with direct-prior and rule-based baselines and with alternative LLM configurations.

item.title: Verifier Noise Is a Temperature: Testing Tilt Predictions in Finite-Budget LLM-Guided Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

LLM-guided search loops propose a modified candidate, score it, and keep it if it scores better. When both candidates are re-scored at every comparison, as in the minibatch acceptance gates of prompt optimizers, keep-if-better is a reversible Markov chain if the score difference is logistic and the mutation operator is reversible, and its stationary law is the mutation equilibrium tilted by exp(beta f). For any continuous symmetric noise difference the same tilt is the stationary law of a small-step diffusion limit, with beta = 4F'(0); for a minibatch gate beta grows with the square root of the minibatch size. Caching the incumbent's score instead inflates the recorded score. item.title: Update Slope Is Bounded by Prior Calibration: A Structural Bound and Its Contingent Empirical Signature
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Evaluations of LLM forecasters increasingly measure how forecasts improve as richer evidence is supplied. We identify two confounds in this update-slope metric. First, outcome-aware evidence construction substantially inflates measured responsiveness: on the same models and questions, slopes are roughly four times larger than with resolution-blinded evidence ladders. Second, update slope is a change score with a prior-dependent structural ceiling, so raw comparisons can reflect differences in starting calibration rather than updating behavior. The ceiling defines only a feasible region; whether slope and prior calibration are empirically coupled depends on headroom utilization and varies across our Manifold, ForecastBench, and ACLED pools. Despite this variability, conditioning on prior calibration roughly triples the association between intermediate updating and final Brier score under both blinded and outcome-aware construction. Question identity also explains substantially more variance than model identity across the evaluated pools. We recommend building evidence ladders blind to outcomes, conditioning on prior calibration, and reporting headroom-normalized measures alongside r…

item.title: UniExit: A Unified Latency-Aware Early-Exit Runtime for Heterogeneous Edge AI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘应用日益把 CNN 感知与可边缘部署的 Transformer 语言模型结合，但推理延迟随输入难度与运行时硬件状态变化，静态早退策略在动态边缘条件下过时——如何统一且延迟感知地控制？

方法：UniExit：把 CNN 块与 Transformer 层抽象为有序 stage，施加统一的延迟感知路由策略（保留模型特定质量机制）；结合运行时状态感知延迟预测、缓存化预测复用、趋势感知回退与 CNN 特定退出稳定化，做预算感知的 continue-or-exit 决策。

关键数字：在多个边缘与边缘-云平台实现并评估；单工作负载、并发异构与边缘-云场景下均持续改善 deadline 满足率与延迟-准确率权衡（原文未给出统一量化数值）。

为什么值得看：异构边缘 AI 在线自适应早退运行时，兼顾低开销、鲁棒与节能。

item.title: TwinHash: Two-Sided Object Identity Management for Time- and Energy-Efficient Agentic Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) services interleave large language model (LLM) generation with external tool execution, and increasingly rely on search-based workflows that repeatedly revisit shared reasoning states and computations. These patterns create substantial redundancy across tool outputs, LLM responses, and key-value (KV) prefixes, yet existing serving systems primarily optimize shared prompt prefixes, while naive input-keyed caching is unsafe when identical requests produce different outputs. We present TwinHash, a unified object management architecture that assigns each object an input-side hash key to recognize repeated requests and an output-side content fingerprint to validate and locate stored state, complemented by type-specific reuse guards that preserve correctness and response diversity. A software object identity table maintains reusable objects across requests and trajectories, while a hardware object placement table tracks their residency across hierarchical memory tiers so that evicted state can be retrieved rather than recomputed. Across seven agent frameworks and five benchmark suites, reuse follows workflow structure more than benchmark identity. Twi…

item.title: Transformer-FSQ: Discrete Latents for Extreme KV-Cache Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：本地消费设备上 KV cache 随上下文线性增长、迅速超过模型本身——现有压缩方法在中等压缩比之外失效，如何实现极端 KV cache 压缩？

方法：Transformer-FSQ：用有限标量量化（FSQ）瓶颈替换标准 key/value 投影，每 token 存打包的离散整数码向量、无逐 token 量化元数据；转换预训练模型只需训练这些投影（每原始参数 0.25 token）；融合 Triton kernel 直接从整数码解码。

关键数字：Qwen3-1.7B-Base 保留 20 万条目需 21 GiB（模型权重的 6.6 倍）；RULER 长上下文检索上 12×–97.5× 压缩为评估中最准方法；Qwen3-8B-Base 在 32× 压缩时解码吞吐为原生 SDPA 的 1.01×、97.5× 时 1.54×。

为什么值得看：极端 KV 压缩让固定设备可容纳的上下文大幅延长，端侧个性化模型直接受益。

item.title: Transferring local rib responses to new component geometries in sheet forming with a graph-based Transformer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Sheet metal components often consist of a global geometry, such as the corner radii and forming depth of a corner component, and local features added to it. During forming, both affect material flow. A surrogate learning all their combinations may need large training data. However, the same local feature type is often used on many global geometries. This study therefore partly decouples local features from the global geometry. The local-feature effect is first learned on one global geometry, needing fewer simulations than learning all combinations, then transferred to other global geometries via transfer learning, which can need fewer target simulations than training from scratch. A baseline-conditioned residual surrogate, R-BiLoGo, is proposed for ribs on the side walls of hot-stamped corner components. Its inputs are the baseline response and the geometric perturbation introduced by the ribs. Its outputs are the changes in displacement and thinning from the baseline. R-BiLoGo gave lower errors than a hierarchical graph-based model and a Transolver-based model on the source geometry, and on two of three selected target geometries after transfer. Across the 22 target geometries, tr…

item.title: Towards Sustainable Federated Learning via Carbon-Aware Client Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

The Information/Communication Technology (ICT) industry is severely challenging the global environment due to the sharply rising carbon emissions generated by machine learning (ML) workloads. Federated Learning (FL) is one of the prominent distributed ML systems used in applications with billions of client devices, such as Google Gboard and Apple Siri. Nearly half of the total carbon footprint in FL originates from client-side computation during local training. However, existing client selection strategies in FL primarily focus on minimizing energy consumption rather than carbon emissions, despite the fact that carbon impact depends not only on computational load but also on the underlying carbon intensity of the energy source. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a carbon-aware fair client selection strategy (CA-FCS) designed to minimize the carbon emissions associated with model training on client devices. In contrast to existing approaches for reducing carbon emissions in FL, we incorporate hourly carbon intensity and a realistic energy consumption model developed using empirical measurements from Google Pixel smartphones to estimate client-side carbon emissions in FL…

item.title: Topology as a Design Variable: Joint Architecture-Sizing Optimization for SRAM
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：SRAM 的功耗-性能-面积-稳定性权衡取决于 bitcell topology 这一离散架构选择，且与连续晶体管尺寸不可分离地交互——但开源 SRAM 工具都不把 topology 当作可优化变量。

方法：OpenYieldV2 三项贡献：全参数化编译器生成完整的 6T/10T SRAM 宏（含外围电路与 replica-bitline 自定时，保证同条件下可比）；few-shot TabPFN 代理模型用少量全宏 SPICE 样本学习 topology 相关 PPA 响应；粗到细多目标优化器联合探索离散拓扑选择与连续尺寸微调。

关键数字：实验显示拓扑决策边界随工作条件约束移动而非固定设计规则；跨该边界联合优化相对最强单拓扑基线 hypervolume 最高提升 17.3%。

为什么值得看：SRAM 设计自动化把 topology 提升为一等设计变量的开源工具链。

item.title: The World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA): Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design for Embedded AI in Robotics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 具身 AI 从感知走向预测：机器人用世界模型在压缩潜空间预测候选动作结果，但每一步都须在功耗与散热受限的板载环境完成，其能耗下界与真实硬件差距未被刻画。

方法 从信息论与布尔电路复杂度推导潜状态转移的算术操作数与 CMOS 动态能耗下界；据此提出 WMPA 芯片架构——近存计算、实时熵估计、可变精度 rollout 单元、写时复制潜 scratchpad。

关键数字 DreamerV3 式 RSSM 的 rollout 全部受内存带宽约束，GPU 能耗至少为 CMOS 能耗下界的 5.9×10^10 倍；持续规划把毫米级硅片加热至 556K；WMPA 以 40x 更低功耗为目标，同尺寸硅片模拟温度 306K。

为什么值得看 给出嵌入式世界模型规划的能量下界到瓶颈再到架构的完整推演链，对机器人端侧推理芯片设计有指导意义。

item.title: The Cost of Coverage: Conformalising Native Forecast Uncertainty for GB Wind Power
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Uncertainty bands on wind forecasts help inform reserve sizing and commitments, but often fail to deliver their stated coverage. We apply conformal prediction to native bands to see what it adds and what it costs, comparing six forecasters, from ARIMA to a tabular foundation model, at two wind farms in Great Britain (GB) under operational conditions. We show that calibration repairs empirical marginal coverage with little or no Winkler Score penalty, but this apparent success conceals under-coverage in high winds. Calibrating by forecast wind regime turns marginal coverage into regime-level coverage, cutting day-ahead out-of-band volume in high winds by over 40% relative to pooled calibration while narrowing bands overall.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sparse Predict and Demote: Optimal Scheduling with Minimal Size Advice
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Knowledge of job sizes is crucial for optimizing the mean response time in single-server scheduling. However, predictions of job sizes are typically inexact and may be costly to obtain. Thus, a long-standing research question is: what is the minimal information about job sizes required to obtain near-optimal mean response time? We introduce a novel policy, \emph{Sparse Predict and Demote (SPD)}, and prove that it achieves order-optimal mean response time in heavy traffic while requiring only one-bit job-size predictions for a vanishing fraction of arrivals. SPD achieves heavy-traffic order-optimality even in situations when predictions are (i) inexact up to any fixed multiplicative error bound, and (ii) costly, i.e., the server is used to compute predictions and is thus unavailable to serve jobs while processing prediction queries. Finally, we use numerical experiments to illustrate that SPD maintains near-optimal performance beyond the heavy-traffic regime.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Solver-Free Decision-Focused Learning via Neural Optimization Layers for Edge Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Decision-focused learning trains prediction models to improve downstream decisions, but many methods require costly solver calls or optimal-solution labels. We propose a solver-free decision-focused learning framework for NP-hard edge-selection problems with uncertain parameters in the objective, the constraints, or both. A neural optimization layer is first trained without solution labels, using problem objectives and constraint penalties. Graph-informed edge scoring and iterative refinement encourage concentrated and structurally consistent continuous decisions. The layer is then frozen, and a prediction model is trained through its continuous output using a problem-specific loss evaluated under observed parameters. At deployment, the predictor, optimization layer, and a lightweight decoder produce decisions without solving the original NP-hard problem. Experiments on the asymmetric traveling salesperson and endpoint-free orienteering problems show consistently better decision quality than prediction-focused learning and improvements over most evaluated decision-focused baselines. Decision-focused learning trains prediction models to improve downstream decisions, but many methods require costly solver calls or optimal-solution labels. We propose a solver-free decision-focused learning framework for NP-hard edge-selection problems with uncertain parameters in the objective, the constraints, or both. A neural optimization layer is first trained without solution labels, using problem objectives and constraint penalties. Graph-informed edge scoring and iterative refinement encourage concentrated and structurally consistent continuous decisions. The layer is then frozen, and a prediction model is trained through its continuous output using a problem-specific loss evaluated under observed parameters. At deployment, the predictor, optimization layer, and a lightweight decoder produce decisions without solving the original NP-hard problem. item.title: Semiprime Factorization with Discrete Diffusion and Beam Search: Scaling Laws
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

We demonstrate that transformer architectures trained with discrete denoising diffusion and decoded via guided test-time beam search can learn to recover the prime factors of semiprime integers directly from data. Our approach establishes a new frontier for learning-based semiprime factorization, successfully factoring 68-bit integers-a substantial advance over the prior 56-bit state of the art. While computationally less efficient than classical factoring algorithms, our model requires no domain-specific number-theoretic priors and learns purely from training examples. In practice, the diffusion model acts as a generative prior, identifying promising factor candidates where exact verification or lattice-based post-processing can complete the factorization. Furthermore, we derive empirical scaling laws relating approximation quality to training data volume, model size, and test-time computation. In contrast to language, problem size is the key driver of scaling behavior. Achieving a fixed accuracy on a held-out test set requires compute that scales exponentially with bit length. Consequently, our findings pose no threat to security, as the projected compute cost required to factori…

item.title: Scaling Graph Similarity Learning with Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Graph similarity computation is an important task in graph mining with many real-world applications, such as chemical compound analysis, program dependence comparison, and social network analysis. The problem is computationally challenging: Graph Edit Distance (GED) and Maximum Common Subgraph (MCS), which quantify the distance between graphs and identify their largest shared subgraph, respectively, are NP-hard to compute exactly. To address these computational challenges, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been applied to this problem. However, existing GNN-based approaches have primarily focused on small-scale graph datasets, while scalability to larger scales remains underexplored. In this work, we propose FiLSim, a scalable GNN-based framework, and investigate whether a simplified GNN pipeline can maintain competitive performance on standard benchmarks while scaling to large graphs. We additionally propose a sequential graph-editing strategy to construct large-scale graph datasets with reliable GED labels to evaluate scalability. The proposed framework is evaluated on four benchmark datasets and four newly created large-scale datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness and scalabi…

item.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill 阶段为 prompt 计算模型大部分上层是否必要——能否跳过上层直接填充 KV cache 以缩短 prefill？

方法：RidgeFill：下层精确运行到 split 层，从 split 层状态出发用逐层映射（对校准文本单趟闭式拟合的 ridge regression）预测每个后续层的输入，各后层从该预测写 cache；无训练、不丢 token，给定行、最后几千 token 与每个解码步仍跑完整模型。

关键数字：Qwen3.8-27B（llama.cpp fork、A100）在 16K–120K token 下 TTFT 快 1.25–1.31×，RULER 变化 -1.2/-1.4 点、LongBench v2 -1.4；Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（vLLM）在 9K–32K token 下比精确计算快 1.50–1.60×，RULER needle 任务 99.8 对 100.0。

为什么值得看：免训练给已发布模型加 prefill 加速，兼容 llama.cpp/vLLM 现有推理栈。

item.title: Rethinking MoE Load Balancing as Feedback Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training is often not stationary: the data mixture changes at curriculum boundaries, when a model is continually pretrained into a new domain, or when the corpus is refreshed. Routing is learned against the current mixture, so each such change disrupts the per-expert load the router had converged to, and existing balancing methods have only been evaluated on stationary data. We rethink load balancing as a feedback control problem, in which the deviation of each expert's load from its fair share is the control error and the per-expert routing bias is the control input, and define a family of controllers, the PID-Balancer, from the proportional, integral, and derivative terms of classical PID control. Two widely used methods belong to this family: the auxiliary balancing loss behaves like a proportional controller, and the loss-free bias update is an integral controller acting on the sign of the error. Reading the router as a static map with a one-step delay, we show that the integral term is the only one that both removes persistent imbalance and averages out the step-to-step fluctuation of the measured load, whereas the proportional and derivative terms pas…

item.title: Rethinking How to Leverage Cheap Physics for Data-Efficient Neural Operators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Neural operators learn mappings from PDE inputs, such as initial conditions and coefficient fields, to the corresponding solutions. Once trained, they can rapidly predict solutions for new inputs. However, obtaining input-solution pairs for supervised training often requires expensive numerical simulations, whereas PDE inputs and governing equations provide inexpensive physical information. This raises a question: how can cheap physical information reduce the need for labeled solutions? A natural approach is to use physics to select inputs for labeling, but our acquisition experiments show no consistent advantage over random sampling. This observation motivates exploring an alternative: using cheap physics to improve neural operator initialization before supervised training. We propose Physics-Informed Initialization (PI-Init), a simple yet effective method that pretrains neural operators on unlabeled inputs using physics-informed losses and retains the learned parameters for supervised fine-tuning on the labeled dataset. A linearized analysis shows that pretraining can improve downstream prediction accuracy by reducing initialization errors that limited labeled data cannot effecti…

item.title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：量化感知训练（QAT）是获得低比特 LLM 的最可靠途径，但 AdamW 为每个权重矩阵保留两个稠密 FP32 状态；低秩内存高效优化器（GaLore、LDAdam）在 QAT 中明显退化——如何保留被投影丢弃的动量残差？

方法：ResQAdam：只保留单个 BF16 momentum，仅对主子空间的 r×r 坐标应用 Adam，对残差施加归一化符号更新（观察到残差仅保留符号仍有用）。

关键数字：两个从零 QAT 方法与三个 QAT 微调流水线（权重量化到 2 bit）上，相对 AdamW 优化器状态内存降低 71–74%，多数设置精度保持接近 AdamW，训练吞吐下降小于 2%。

为什么值得看：QAT 场景下"内存高效优化器精度不崩"的新解，低比特训练直接受益。

item.title: Repeating Work Can Lower Energy per Successful Goal in LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

When a temporary call failure interrupts a tool-using LLM agent, the framework must choose how much completed work to repeat. Repeating less completed work intuitively saves computation, but recovery mechanisms also change subsequent execution and the chance of success. We compare recovery mechanisms by energy per successful goal (EpG), which divides the energy of all task runs (including failed runs) by the number that finish correctly. In controlled vLLM experiments on one node, we measure board energy above idle for eight recovery options on reliably solved multi-turn tasks, with selected comparisons across three model families. For the model tested across all eight options, with the prefix cache retained, starting over has 22 percent lower EpG than continuing after early failures. Under the same cache condition, continuing has 24 percent lower EpG than starting over after late failures. Among all eight recovery options, repeating only the interrupted turn has the lowest observed EpG after early and late tool failures on this model. Holding recovery fixed, retaining the prefix cache reduces prompt tokens needing fresh computation by 86 percent but reduces recovery energy by only…

item.title: Reliable Prerequisite-Aware Learning Path Recommendation under Uncertain Knowledge Structures: Long-Horizon Evaluation and Cross-Dataset Validation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Learning-path recommendation often depends on knowledge and prerequisite structures whose reliability is uncertain, while high accuracy in predicting the next resource does not necessarily establish reliable long-horizon path behaviour. This study develops a reliability-oriented prerequisite-aware framework that jointly examines immediate next-resource ranking, uncertain prerequisite structures, hard, soft and hybrid constraint semantics, graph robustness, and autoregressive path generation under course-level confirmatory evaluation and independent cross-dataset validation. Development used 3,187 MOOCCubeX courses, followed by a frozen confirmatory evaluation on 541 held-out courses and 37,747 transitions. The primary MOOCCubeX task is structural and course-prefix-conditioned rather than learner-personalised. Junyi provides independent structure-/hierarchy-aware external validation, uses hierarchy metadata rather than an explicit prerequisite graph and is not a zero-shot transfer setting. On the frozen MOOCCubeX evaluation, XGBoost pairwise was the strongest observed immediate ranker, with mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.9048, whereas the proposed prerequisite-aware graph model ach…

item.title: Reconstructing LLM Lineage Trees via Fine-Tuning Path Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Fine-tuned (FT) derivatives of large language models (LLMs) are now released in large numbers, yet their provenance relies on self-reports and cannot be verified. Misattributed lineage leaves a verifier unable to audit outsourced fine-tuning, confirm license compliance of derived models, or trace vulnerabilities that a parent passes to its children. All three require the direction of derivation, not merely its presence. Existing output-only methods are limited to pairwise derivation tests or undirected lineage estimation, while recovering a directed tree requires white-box access to model weights. We formalize the problem of reconstructing a directed model tree, including internal nodes, under gray-box access, where only teacher-forced log-likelihoods are observed and weights are never inspected. Fine-tuning raises the log-likelihood of the training data, and a child inherits this increase from its parent. Building on this property, we define an asymmetric per-task log-likelihood deviation between any two models as a trace of fine-tuning history, and derive from it an edge weight for each ordered pair of models. We propose TRACE-Edge, which exactly solves for the maximum spanning d…

item.title: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：RL 已成为训练推理模型（RLM）的核心，但流水线多模型耦合、阶段异构、跨步状态与复杂异步依赖使其难扩展、成本高——如何联合优化流水线结构与执行？

方法：RPEG：数据中心的图中间表示，暴露有界异步、actor-critic 共享等结构选择，以及阶段融合、细粒度调度、多维模型并行等执行优化；配套联合刻画计算/通信/内存与 rack/node/GPU 层级效应的分析性能模型。

关键数字：最高 256 张 GH200 的系统上，相对 ReaL 性能最高提升 2×，相对 verl 步延迟最高降低 2.48×，硬件利用率最高提高 30%。

为什么值得看：推理模型 RL 训练流水线的图驱动基础架构，为前沿推理 LLM 训练提供新底座。

item.title: PACE: Keeping the Right Tokens in the KV Cache Is Not Enough for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长程 LLM agent 会话可达百万 token 级 KV cache，远超单 GPU 容量；现有驱逐方法只保证「需要的 token 还在缓存里」，但 token 在位不等于可取回。

方法 提出 PACE（Planner-Aware Context Engine）：① 计划感知保留——由 agent 的 planner 告知缓存未来步骤将读取哪些上下文；② 有界位置重编号——重排保留 token 使其旋转位置距离在任意会话长度下低于 8K。

关键数字 100K token 会话、2,048 token 预算下，保留 99%+ 所需 token 的策略准确率仍从 93% 跌至 64%；PACE 通过 97% 隐藏单元测试（H2O 42%、SnapKV 3%）；1M/2M token 会话在单张 24GB GPU 上通过 99%/100% 检查，KV 占用 <0.7GB（全量需 147–295GB），仅增 9% 墙钟时间。

为什么值得看 指出「保留正确 token」之外的第二个瓶颈——位置距离可取回性，并给出无需重读历史的工程解法。

阅读原文

发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

方法 提出 PACE（Planner-Aware Context Engine）：① 计划感知保留——由 agent 的 planner 告知缓存未来步骤将读取哪些上下文；② 有界位置重编号——重排保留 token 使其旋转位置距离在任意会话长度下低于 8K。

关键数字 100K token 会话、2,048 token 预算下，保留 99%+ 所需 token 的策略准确率仍从 93% 跌至 64%；PACE 通过 97% 隐藏单元测试（H2O 42%、SnapKV 3%）；1M/2M token 会话在单张 24GB GPU 上通过 99%/100% 检查，KV 占用 <0.7GB（全量需 147–295GB），仅增 9% 墙钟时间。

为什么值得看 指出「保留正确 token」之外的第二个瓶颈——位置距离可取回性，并给出无需重读历史的工程解法。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for automating data science workflows. Benchmarks such as DataSciBench (2026) and StatQA (2024) have advanced the evaluation of their capabilities across data science and statistical tasks. Assessing their reliability requires examining both the quality of their responses and their consistency across repeated runs, task types, and difficulty levels. With this aim, we introduce DS-QA, a benchmark comprising 100 data science and statistics questions drawn from UK university courses, spanning 16 datasets and three difficulty levels. We develop a three-layer evaluation framework that combines general response properties (runtime, verbosity and text similarity), coarse-grained metrics (accuracy, code executability and completeness), and task-specific metrics. We evaluate OpenAI models using a Monte Carlo protocol with 100 repeated runs. The results reveal substantial variability in responses to data visualisation and supervised learning tasks, particularly at medium and hard difficulty levels, highlighting the importance of evaluating consistency alongside response quality. item.title: Nebula: Distributed Position-Independent Caching for LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Modern LLM workflows, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and LLM agents, build long prompts from multiple independent text segments, making prefill a major source of computation. Reusing KV caches is therefore important for reducing serving costs and latency: distributed caching systems spread KV cache across a cluster to increase aggregate capacity, while position-independent caching (PIC) enables reuse of recurring segments under different prefixes. However, existing systems distribute KV caches but still rely on prefix caching (PC), while existing PIC methods enable position-independent reuse without cluster-wide resource management. We present Nebula, the first distributed LLM serving framework to treat PIC segments as first-class citizens, enabling remote PIC reuse and parallel prefill. To track PIC's fine-grained, asynchronous state changes, Nebula combines optimistic accounting with event-driven updates to provide a timely and truthful cluster view for cache management and prefill scheduling. To accommodate diverse reuse patterns across workloads, Nebula leverages cluster-wide ghost-hit feedback to automatically tune the allocation of shared cache capacity between …

item.title: Mosaic:montage-agnostic self-distilled graph learning for subject-independent ieeg seizure detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Intracranial EEG provides high signal-to-noise ratio and spatial resolution for detecting epileptic activity, but patient-specific electrode placement leads to substantial variation in channel count and montage across subjects. This heterogeneity limits the generalization of existing detectors under subject-independent evaluation. We propose MOSAIC (MOntage-agnostic Self-distilled Adaptive Inter-channel Connectivity learning), a lightweight graph-learning framework for subject-independent iEEG seizure detection. MOSAIC pairs a shared convolutional channel encoder with a patient-agnostic channel-attention module that infers a weighted inter-channel adjacency matrix from the encoded features, requiring no fixed montage graph. An exponential moving average self-distillation objective regularizes each prediction toward a slowly updated per-patient teacher. Across four public iEEG corpora (SWEC-ETHZ long- and short-term, Mayo, FNUSA), MOSAIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in F2 and Cohen's $κ$ while learning more stable inter-channel adjacencies, demonstrating that self-distilled connectivity learning transfers across unseen implantations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: More with Less: Efficient Parallel Scientific Code Translation via an Agent-Skill Workflow
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Translating parallel scientific codes between HPC programming frameworks is a critical but labor-intensive task. Existing LLM-based approaches rely on fixed sequential pipelines with undifferentiated repair strategies and correctness criteria that do not match scientific computing practice. We present an agent-skill framework that separates translation, compilation diagnosis, and execution validation into three autonomous agents coordinated by a verdict-driven orchestrator, routing each failure to a targeted repair skill rather than retrying blindly. An automated output check drives the self-correction loop, complemented by an offline LLM-based verification that exposes false positives escaping compiler and runtime checks. We evaluate the framework on 30 HeCBench kernels translated bidirectionally among CUDA, OpenMP, and SYCL with three open-source LLMs. Our framework attains the higher verified correctness rate in all 18 model and direction combinations over a state-of-the-art baseline while consuming up to 52.4% fewer tokens, remaining consistent across models and directions without architectural modification.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Memory as a Temporal Resource: Lifetime Contracts for Multi-Retention Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Computers move and rewrite data whose useful lifetimes range from inner-loop iterations to years, yet memory systems usually hide retention as a fixed physical property. We argue that required lifetime should become a first-class resource across algorithms, programming systems, controllers, and devices. Building on prior lifetime-aware placement, we propose an event-based validity contract that links application completion events to retention-class selection and renewal of protection. Applications would be enabled to express semantic contracts such as ``until this tile completes'' and the system will map data to homogeneous arrays engineered for ephemeral, epoch, or durable retention and preserve correctness through margins, ECC, refresh, migration, or recomputation. We present a trace-based simulator and FPGA prototype that exercises class migration.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: MINE: Entropy-coded Memory-efficient Inference for Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：单流 LLM 推理强内存受限（每生成一个 token 每个权重都要从内存流一遍，本地/低延迟部署无法批处理）——无损熵编码能否加速？

方法：MINE：核心是 dtANS-LLM，一个为 LLM 推理改造的 GPU 熵编码方案，利用量化后仍存在的权重非均匀分布；暴露压缩率与解码成本的超参数，按 tensor 与 GPU 自动调参得到模型大小与解码延迟的 Pareto 前沿；以 vLLM 插件集成并按内存预算选择最佳 kernel 配置。

关键数字：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct + 2.1-bit EntQuant checkpoint 上，相对最快基线 RTX 4060 Ti 加速 2.52×、RTX 5090 加速 1.48×，有效比特率 2.24 与 3.43 bits/weight。

为什么值得看：无损熵编码攻内存瓶颈的新方案，开源且直接集成 vLLM。

item.title: Knowledge Distillation from Neural Networks to Differentiable Logic Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Differentiable logic networks (DLNs) are interpretable, edge-friendly classifiers that learn both their logic operators and their connections through gradient descent, achieving accuracy competitive with multi-layer perceptrons at orders-of-magnitude lower inference cost. Their accuracy, however, is bounded by the problems of vanishing gradients, scalability, and lack of an ecosystem, leaving a gap relative to conventional neural networks on several datasets. We introduce knowledge distillation for DLNs to narrow this gap. We distill from a trained multi-layer perceptron teacher into a DLN student, integrating the distillation objective into a two-phase training loop without altering the architecture or the inference procedure. The teacher is discarded after training. Hence, the distilled model retains the interpretability, sparsity, and inference cost of a conventionally trained DLN. We investigate this approach through four variants: a joint hyperparameter search that optimizes the distillation weight and temperature alongside the architecture, a grid search over these two hyperparameters with the architecture fixed, and two single-phase variants that employ distillation during o…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: KnowEvo: Knowledge Evolution for Protein Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in scientific discovery, yet systematically accumulating and refining reusable scientific knowledge remains challenging. Existing approaches primarily improve LLM-based problem solving through parameter optimization or feedback-driven refinement of prompts, programs, and solution trajectories, leaving acquired expertise either embedded in model weights or scattered across iterative problem-solving processes. As a result,knowledge is difficult to systematically inspect, evaluate, and refine. We propose KnowEvo, a framework that treats externalized knowledge itself as the optimization target. Our key insight is that scientific knowledge is inherently modular: multiple interacting mechanisms jointly determine the design outcomes. This makes knowledge evolution fundamentally challenging, as improvements cannot be attributed to individual components in isolation. To address this, KnowEvo represents knowledge as executable expertise blocks and organizes their refinements into strategy mutation trees, enabling structured exploration over a combinatorial knowledge space. The framework combines a Thompson-style forward allocation strategy that…

item.title: Know What You Need: Efficient Activation Checkpointing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大模型训练受内存容量约束，激活检查点通过前向不存激活、反向再物化省内存，但再物化开销大（尤其 Transformer 线性层）——能否用近似计算降本且保持梯度无偏？

方法：利用前向过程收集的信息，只选择性重算最重要的层组件（贪心选择或随机 sketching），得到无偏梯度估计；消融显示所得梯度与精确梯度高度接近。

关键数字：Llama-488M 上仅需重算三分之二的层组件：只作用于 FFN 时 perplexity 增 1.7%，只作用于 attention 时增 1.2%，两者都作用时增 2.5%。

为什么值得看：内存受限大模型训练的新检查点策略，用很小的精度代价换大量重算开销。

item.title: Inside the Trap: A Renewal Law for Prefix-Cache Collapse in LLM Agent Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：前缀缓存让 LLM agent 后续轮次复用 KV，但突发流量可能使引擎陷入"每轮 miss、积压不排空"的陷阱——机理是什么、如何防止？

方法：注册配对实验 + 对陷阱态的理想化精确分析：对每轮都 miss 的流体 FIFO 服务，证明沿 FIFO 轨道各循环满足线性更新递归；并对比两种退出机制（拒绝到达 vs session cap）。

关键数字：两引擎/两 GPU/两模型配对测试（9/10 比率通过），200-session 突发让引擎在 30 次运行中全部零命中到底，无突发对照全部保持良好，session cap 在 30 次封顶运行中全部防住陷阱；理论在未拟合陷阱数据的条件下匹配 57 个卡死运行（50 次平均 served prompt 误差 3% 内）。

为什么值得看：LLM agent serving 前缀缓存崩溃的首次理论刻画与可落地对策（session cap）。

item.title: ISER-MoE: Dynamic In-Switch Replication of Hot Experts for Load Balancing in Expert-Parallel
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：专家并行 MoE 层以最忙 GPU 为步调，少数热专家承担大部分超额负载；复制热专家又受 owner 广播瓶颈制约——如何高效复制？

方法：ISER-MoE（TensorRT-LLM 内实现）：通过 NVLink switch 向固定 GPU 组多播热专家，每个字节只离开 owner 一次；GPU 调度器逐层把热专家分配给组，多端口广播把注入分散到组内端口，并与共享专家重叠执行。

关键数字：trace replay 中调度器消除 98–99% 的超额负载；DeepSeek-V4-Pro prefill 服务中，数学基准吞吐提升 17.4%，agentic prompts 吞吐提升 7.2%。

为什么值得看：MoE 负载均衡的交换机级方案，已在生产推理框架中落地，收益可观。

item.title: Green500: Adventure in Qualifying a Cluster
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Energy effciency has become a key metric for evaluating High Performance Computing (HPC) systems, as reflected by the Green500 ranking. However, energy effciency alone does not capture the full environmental impact of an HPC cluster. Using the Kuma cluster at EPFL, we report on two Green500 measurement campaigns at Level 2 and Level 3, and extend this analysis to a full carbon footprint assessment using the MITSI life-cycle based methodology. GPU power capping experiments show that energy effciency peaks at 450 W, achieving an 11% performance loss offset by a 20% reduction in energy consumption. When embodied emissions are accounted for, the optimal power cap for carbon effciency shifts to 500 W under Switzerland's low-carbon electrical grid, revealing a tension between minimizing usage and embodied contributions. We discuss the challenges of generalizing this approach into a broader carbon-based HPC ranking, and argue that moving beyond energy effciency is both necessary and feasible.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original's key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer, a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39-44% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3-1.5% with another skill's adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 external skills its documents restore 85-91% of the original's task gain. These strongest results are on adapters whose training stored the document; adapters trained on behaviour alone are much harder for trained writers (1-2% of instructions). item.title: FondueQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Parametric Compensation in Multi-Hop QA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Large Language Models (LLMs) show remarkable performance based on parametric knowledge, i.e., their ability to recall facts and associations internalized in a model's weights. However, studying this capability on established multi-hop benchmarks may be complicated by benchmark contamination, as many of these benchmarks have been publicly available long enough to plausibly appear in modern pretraining corpora. As a result, correct answers under missing evidence may reflect either general parametric knowledge or memorization of benchmark-specific instances. To study how models use internal knowledge when retrieval evidence is incomplete, we introduce FondueQA, in which every required multi-hop fact is uniquely localized to a designated evidence document. This enables controlled document-level evidence ablations to study parametric compensation under incomplete retrieval. Our empirical evaluation reveals that parametric compensation strongly depends on both entity popularity and the structural role of missing evidence. Generally, models compensate more successfully for facts involving popular entities. On FondueQA, we show that bridging evidence can be more useful than the answer-bear…

item.title: Fixed-point acceleration on Neural Wasserstein manifolds
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

We propose a fixed-point acceleration method for optimization over probability measures, applicable to a variety of machine learning problems. We represent probability measures as pushforwards of a reference distribution through a neural network map and equip the parameter space with the induced pullback Wasserstein metric. This geometric structure allows natural gradient descent to be interpreted as a fixed-point iteration on a Riemannian manifold. We accelerate this iteration using Riemannian Anderson mixing method, which exploits historical residuals to capture approximate second-order information without forming Hessians. In the present parametric setting, the manifold is represented by Euclidean coordinates endowed with a point-dependent metric, simplifying retraction and vector transport. We evaluate the method on multimodal sampling, PDE-based inverse problems, aggregation dynamics, Bayesian logistic regression, and generative modeling. Across the tested tasks, Anderson mixing reduces the number of natural-gradient iterations and achieves competitive performance relative to SGD and Adam in terms of both loss-gradient evaluations and wall-clock time. item.title: FirstSwap: Pre-Consensus Trade Approvals for Decentralized Market Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Decentralized exchanges typically give traders no execution guarantee until a block is finalized. In the meantime, external prices move, traders strategically delay submission, and block producers can influence inclusion and ordering. We introduce FirstSwap, a DEX built on a constant-function market maker pricing curve that gives traders an early pre-approval before consensus, guaranteeing inclusion and execution within their submitted price limit, with final ordering determined by limit prices rather than by a block producer. We demonstrate the benefits of trade pre-approvals in an economic model combining auction theory with CEX-DEX arbitrage. When the CEX price changes gradually, FirstSwap rewards earlier traders with better prices, discouraging strategic delay and yielding higher social welfare and gains to AMM liquidity providers than a batch auction. When the CEX price jumps abruptly, FirstSwap yields higher welfare and smaller AMM losses than fair ordering. The central challenge is delivering fast trade pre-approvals without consensus. We introduce a decentralized, scaled admissibility protocol under which each validator reserves only a fraction of the available liquidity at…

item.title: FedLoVA: Value-Only Aggregation for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method for fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), especially in federated learning, due to its strong performance and communication efficiency. In practice, LoRA is applied to the query and value projections of transformer layers without considering the distinct roles of these components. In this work, we analyze the impact of these projections in federated fine-tuning of LLMs using LoRA and observe that the value projection converges significantly faster than the query projection. Motivated by this finding, we propose FedLoVA, a federated fine-tuning framework that trains LoRA adapters on both query and value projections locally while sharing only the value projection with the server. This approach reduces communication overhead while improving convergence efficiency. Experiments on natural language understanding, multilingual sentiment analysis, and generation tasks show that FedLoVA reduces the communication cost by up to $7.8\times$ compared to existing federated LLM fine-tuning baselines while achieving comparable or better performance. The code is available at: this https URL.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Fast and Actionable Classification of HPC I/O Time Series
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：HPC 作业共享并行文件系统时 I/O 竞争严重，解决它需要刻画作业的时间 I/O 行为——如何轻量、快速且可行动地分类？

方法：SAGE：把 I/O trace 切成短窗口并学习一个字母表，trace 变成符号序列（"genome"），再用聚类分成类别；两阶段变体 SAGE-2 进一步提速。

关键数字：在 2 个 HPC 系统的 819,771 条真实 trace 上评估；相对最佳基线 K-shape，SAGE-2 中位簇内指标平均降低 9.1%，聚类耗时 2 分钟对比 3.8 小时（109× 加速）；用簇质心指导 I/O 调度，相对 round-robin 的 SOTA 方案 I/O stretch 最多降低 24%。

为什么值得看：HPC I/O 行为分类从"事后分析"变成"可行动调度"，速度快一个数量级以上。

item.title: EventHOI: Event-Driven Resource-Efficient Hand-Object Interaction Logging on Smartglasses
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：智能眼镜连续 RGB 采集与无线传输超出能量与带宽预算——如何低功耗地从第一人称视角记录手-物交互（HOI）？

方法：EventHOI：事件驱动感知与压缩系统，用低功耗事件传感判断何时需要 RGB 采集、以及何处必须保留视觉细节；轻量 IMU 的 egomotion 消除管线抑制自身运动产生的事件，让残余 HOI 运动引导 RGB 触发与空间压缩；构建了智能眼镜原型。

关键数字：50 小时基准（97 名受试者）+ 自行采集的 20 小时真实数据（10 名参与者）；相对 RGB-only 基线，常开后端功耗降低 5.8–10.4×，上行带宽降低 2.9×，HOI 识别精度损失很小；RGB 上行 <130 kbps，适配消费级 BLE 带宽。

为什么值得看：端侧持续感知的能耗-带宽联合优化范式，记忆辅助类眼镜应用的关键使能技术。

item.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Looping is a powerful inductive bias for reasoning. By repeatedly iterating a recurrent block, looped models can scale their effective depth and enable multi-step reasoning in latent space. However, existing looped models are not inherently guided by an explicit measure of progress, making it difficult to determine when to stop looping and how to improve upon the current state. To enable this, we introduce Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs), which learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and formulate looped updates as gradient descent on this energy. The energy scores latent states, while its gradient guides refinement and provides a signal for stopping. To train EBRs effectively, we further introduce exploration-based training to discover additional modes and to better shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. Across four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, EBRs match or outperform prior recurrent reasoning models, achieving 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme while using 345$\times$ less inference compute than the next-best model and maintaining comparable training compute. On all multi-solution benchmarks, EBRs achieve state-of-the-art coverage of distinct val…

item.title: Diversity-Aware Client Selection for Communication-Efficient Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, making it attractive for privacy-sensitive and bandwidth-constrained applications. A practical challenge in deploying FL is reducing communication overhead while maintaining model performance under heterogeneous, non-IID data distributions. Selecting which subset of clients participates in each training round offers a principled way to address both challenges simultaneously, yet its impact on data diversity and representativeness remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate three client selection strategies, Power-of-Choice, Fisher information, and Centered Kernel Alignment, evaluating them not only by accuracy and convergence, but through the lens of participation diversity using the Gini coefficient and KL divergence. Under non-IID conditions, restricting participation to 15% of clients per round achieves significant communication savings, and when selection promotes diverse and balanced contributions, it also improves generalization over biased alternatives. This work provides a systematic and reproducible analysis demonstrating that diversity-focused client …

item.title: DisMUSE: An Efficient Distributed Singular-Spectrum-Based Optimization Approach with Theoretical Convergence Guarantee
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

In recent years, singular-spectrum-based optimizers have attracted increasing attention due to their ability to preserve the matrix structure of neural network gradients, thereby enabling geometry-aware optimization. However, most singular-spectrum-based (SSB) approaches remain centralized, limiting their use in distributed learning infrastructures that exploit massive parallelism. Distributed SSB optimization is still at an early stage, with open questions about convergence guarantees and communication efficiency. To fill this gap, we propose the Distributed Momentum-based Spectral Estimator (DisMUSE), an efficient distributed SSB optimization framework for both data-center and federated settings. Using Muon-style exact orthogonalized momentum as the spectral update, DisMUSE integrates a recursive variance-reduced momentum estimator and achieves an $O((KT)^{-1/3})$ convergence rate, where $K$ and $T$ denote the number of nodes and local iterations per node, respectively. This rate matches the best-known rates for variance-reduced nonconvex distributed optimization. Building on this variance-reduced framework, we study two extensions. First, our DisMUSE method with finite Newton-Sc…
