item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Cross-location variation in wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) signals complicates learning when measurements from a desired target body location are unavailable. This study proposes DiffusionRef-IMU, a two-stage cross-location translation framework in which a deterministic Direct network first estimates the target signal and a guide-anchored residual diffusion model refines only the remaining target discrepancy. The evaluation comprises five subject-disjoint activity-location composition-held-out folds, capacity-matched deterministic and flow-based residual baselines, source-only activity conditioning, computational ablation, and true zero-shot evaluation on two independent datasets. DiffusionRef-IMU with 16-step deterministic DDIM achieved a mean nRMSE of 0.087538 +/- 0.004922, compared with 0.090262 for Direct, 0.088847 for deterministic residual refinement, and 0.088417 for eight-step CompFlow, and outperformed each baseline in all five folds. item.title: Diffusion-free Score Matching for Exact Conditional Sampling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

The success of modern score-based generative models is largely driven by diffusion-based training, which learns a collection of time-indexed score fields corresponding to progressively noisier versions of the data distribution. While such models achieve impressive sample quality, leveraging them for sound probabilistic inference---particularly sampling from arbitrary conditionals of the model---remains challenging. This difficulty arises because conditioning information is only available for clean data and not for the higher noise levels required to generate exact conditional samples. In this paper, we introduce DIffusion-free SCOre matching (DISCO), a principled approach that sidesteps the need for time-dependent score fields altogether. Our method is based on an objective that, while reminiscent of diffusion-based training, estimates only a single score of the (slightly perturbed) data distribution, for which the exact conditional score is readily obtained. In experiments, DISCO is competitive with state-of-the-art diffusion models in terms of sample quality. More importantly, DISCO yields a more faithful representation of the underlying data distribution and---crucially---enable…

item.title: DexDICE: Reconciling Safety and Performance via Dual-Expert Offline Imitation Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Ensuring high returns while providing strong safety guarantees in offline imitation learning (IL) is a fundamental challenge: existing approaches either rely on explicitly specified cost functions, which are difficult to design for complex real-world safety constraints, or require expert demonstrations that are both safe and high-performing, which are often too costly to collect. We introduce dual-expert imitation learning, which leverages two complementary data sources: (i) safety-compliant demonstrations that faithfully follow safety guidelines but may be suboptimal, and (ii) performance-oriented demonstrations that achieve high returns but may violate safety guidelines. To address this problem, we propose DexDICE (Dual-expert offline imitation learning via stationary DIstribution Correction Estimation). Instead of conventional distribution constraints, DexDICE combines DICE-style offline learning with safe support constraints, enabling agents to exploit high-return behaviors while remaining within safety-compliant regions. We prove that the ideal solution satisfying this constraint exactly has zero unsafe-region visitation with high probability. We evaluate DexDICE on a re-curat…

item.title: DataHelix: A CPU-GPU Co-Scheduling Data Plane for Multimodal Model Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal model training breaks the loose coupling between data loading and model execution assumed by conventional training pipelines. Large per-sample variation in decoding cost, token/latent count, and tensor size causes both CPU preprocessing time and GPU compute time to vary substantially across data-parallel ranks (training processes). In synchronous training, these two sources of heterogeneity interact tightly: GPU execution determines how long the input pipeline has to prepare the next batch, while delayed preprocessing in any rank in turn stalls all GPUs at synchronization. As a result, optimizing CPU throughput or GPU load balance in isolation cannot eliminate pipeline bubbles. We present DataHelix, a metadata-first CPU-GPU co-scheduling data plane for multimodal training. DataHelix jointly reasons about preprocessing demand and GPU execution progress, treating each GPU compute window as the readiness budget for the next batch and coordinating preprocessing across ranks to minimize deadline misses rather than CPU makespan. To avoid expensive data movement, placement is decided while samples remain lightweight descriptors, before decoding and collation amplify them into l…

item.title: DARIC: A Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse System with Distribution-Aware Recomputation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：agentic 系统与 RAG 中上下文不断变长，位置无关 KV cache 复用依赖重算 token 子集恢复跨块交互，但现有方案 token 选择开销高、质量差且依赖定制执行流——如何系统-算法协同设计？

方法：DARIC：基于经验 KV 偏差分布的自适应 token 选择策略，按偏差模式调度重算；轻量系统架构让独立 KV cache 生成与重算以最小集成开销接入，完整保留推理引擎既有优化。

关键数字：跨多种数据集与 LLM，一致优于 SOTA 方法，TTFT 提速 1.1×–4.5×，生成质量损失可忽略。

为什么值得看：长上下文推理 KV 复用兼顾质量与部署友好，代码已开源（github.com/Lenovo-ICI/DARIC）。

item.title: Cross-Layer TopK: Dynamically Allocating Sparsity Across Layers in Transcoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) decompose the activations of large language models into human-interpretable features and trace how these features interact across layers to form circuits, making them a key tool for mechanistic interpretability. However, training CLTs effectively and efficiently is hard. Beyond the usual trade-off between sparsity and reconstruction quality, a CLT has to model all layers at once, which adds a further challenge. The common JumpReLU recipe controls sparsity only indirectly through a penalty, while the direct extension of TopK selects a fixed number of latents in every layer. Yet reconstruction difficulty differs widely across layers, and intermediate layers are much harder than others, so giving every layer the same budget is suboptimal. We propose Cross-Layer TopK, which sets a single L0 budget for the whole model and dynamically allocates it across layers during training. In a comparison with JumpReLU and other TopK variants on Qwen3-8B-Base, this gives lower FVU while using 20% fewer active latents than JumpReLU. The better reconstruction carries over to circuit tracing, yielding more complete circuits with higher replacement and completeness scores.…

item.title: Copies Are Not Confirmations: How News Duplication Fools LLM Judges and Continual Learners
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Many news reports of a claim are copies of one source: wire stories, content shared within a media group, syndicated features and press releases. We ask whether LLM judges and continual learners treat such copies as independent confirmations. In 200,000 English CC-News articles, a MinHash detector links 18.9% to a near-copy from another outlet (precision 0.97 once boilerplate is removed); it links 92% of edited reprints to their originals but none of the LLM rewrites by phi4, Llama 3.2 or Gemini 2.5 Flash. Shown three identical reprints of a claim about an unknown person instead of one report, Llama 3.2 3B and phi4 14B raised the share of lies they accepted from 0.06 to 0.71 and from 0.21 to 0.90 and ignored a note that the reports came from one source; Gemini 2.5 Flash already believed a single report, and Gemini 2.5 Pro followed provenance notes and tables. In a simulated continual-learning stream, showing the judge one report per detected chain cut the copied lies it accepted by 0.10-0.24 across four judges, at a mean cost of no more than 4.2 percentage points of accepted truths. item.title: Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 多智能体系统中多个 agent 的 KV cache 同时驻留内存成为瓶颈，各模型独立做量化会忽略不同 agent 的精度需求差异，损害集体推理。

方法 提出 CoMixKV 协同混合精度 KV 量化框架：在线敏感度估计（基于近期 query/key/value 的局部注意力误差界，无需校准数据、试量化或额外模型前向）+ 共享内存预算下的跨 agent 联合位宽分配；分配随 agent 启停与新观测动态刷新，只作用于新量化块。

关键数字 平均 3-bit 下 Gemma-4-31B-it 上准确率 68.35%，超过最强量化基线 0.59%；Qwen3-32B 上峰值 KV cache 内存降 32.08%，相对 FullKV 推理加速 1.38x。

为什么值得看 首个在共享内存预算下跨同时驻留 agent cache 联合分配精度的混合精度 KV 量化框架，多智能体推理优化的新维度。

item.title: Controllable Molecule Generation via Sparse Representation Editing: An Interpretability-Driven Perspective
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Controllable molecule generation is crucial for diverse scientific applications, such as drug discovery and materials design. While large language models (LLMs) show great promise, their dense and entangled representations impede precise control over the generation of molecules with bespoke substructures or properties. To address this, we propose Sparse Representation Editing (SpaRE), an interpretability-driven framework for fine-grained and precise control in LLM-based molecule generation. The crux of SpaRE is to learn an overcomplete sparse feature space that disentangles LLM representations into a compact set of latent features corresponding to chemically meaningful concepts. Within this space, we can directly manipulate these concept-aligned latent features to achieve (1) local control, by generating target atoms and functional groups at specified positions; and (2) global control, by customizing the overall structural and physicochemical properties within defined ranges. In this way, our framework advances interpretability from post-hoc analysis to actionable generative control. item.title: Continual Instruction Tuning for LLM-ased Management of Continuum Resources
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for resource management across the Cloud-Edge continuum. However, embedding LLMs directly inside latency-sensitive control loops places inference latency, execution jitter, and hallucination risks on the critical path. This study argues for a different use of LLMs: a continually instruction-tuned intent compiler that runs once per management intent or declared context change, above a fast, deterministic tactical controller that handles all low-latency runtime actions. We formulate intent compilation as a continual instruction tuning problem, because management intents arrive sequentially and accumulate while infrastructure and workload contexts drift. Unlike recent LLM-based management frameworks, our design scores the model's outputs by execution, so that catastrophic forgetting can be measured in the executed objective of the underlying controller. On a continuum simulator with a 2B backbone and parameter-efficient adapters, preliminary results show that naive sequential tuning forgets earlier intents in the executed objective, that replay of stored examples nearly prevents this forgetting, and that the tuned compact compiler…

item.title: Consensus-Constrained Dual-Federated Optimization with Client-Side Dynamic Weighting for Distributed Android Device Threat Defense
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Smartphones, smart-home hubs, and wearables are increasingly exposed to sophisticated Android malware, while centralized threat-detection pipelines raise privacy and scalability concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without collecting raw client data, but partial participation and variation in local model quality can destabilize global optimization. In this article, we propose DW-FedADMM, a federated optimization framework that combines primal-dual coordination with performance-dependent client-side weighting. The dynamic coefficient modulates each participating client's local state before the augmented-Lagrangian update, while the dual variables regulate disagreement between local and global model states. We evaluate DW-FedADMM on three Android malware benchmarks, namely Drebin, Malgenome, and TUANDROMD, with 5, 10, and 15 clients holding IID data shards, partial client participation, and communication budgets of 5 and 10 rounds. Each configuration is repeated with ten random seeds. DW-FedADMM obtains the highest seed-averaged accuracy on Drebin (97.64% +/- 0.20%) and the best mean accuracy in 9 of the 18 dataset-client-round configurations, includ…

item.title: Concurrent Use of FP32 and FP64 Computing Units on GPUs and Mixed-Precision Placement in WENO Reconstruction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Scientific computing often requires FP64 arithmetic, although FP64 performance is limited on NVIDIA GPUs. Double-float (DF) emulation, which represents a value using two FP32 values with about 48 bits of significand, outperforms native FP64 where FP64 units are limited. On the other hand, mixed-precision strategies offload to FP32 the operations that do not determine accuracy. In both approaches, the native FP64 units remain idle during FP32 instruction execution. We investigated whether this idle resource can be recovered on A100, GH200, GB200, and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q. A microbenchmark shows that co-resident FP32 and native-FP64 kernels exceed the throughput of the faster kernel alone on A100 but not on GH200 and GB200; on RTX 6000 Blackwell, they do so against FFMA but, against DF emulation, only when the issue density of the DF kernel is reduced. We then tested whether this gain carries over to computing the WENO-Z reconstruction with the nonlinear weights in FP32 and the candidate polynomials in native FP64 (W32P64). We observe substantial overlap on A100, whereas GH200, GB200, and RTX 6000 Blackwell show little overlap. Importantly, the fastest placement does not alwa…

item.title: Composable Causality: A Toolkit for Systematic Time-Series Causal Discovery and Treatment-Effect Benchmarking
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Real-world multivariate time series rarely come with verified ground-truth causal structure, so research on time-series causal discovery and treatment-effect estimation depends on synthetic data. Existing tools are either fixed datasets that cannot be modified after release or script-based generators in which each script fixes one combination of mechanism, confounding, and missingness. Neither supports controlled experiments that vary a single property, such as sparsity, noise distribution, or missingness mechanism, while holding the others fixed. Counterfactual evaluation has the same gap, since existing simulators are built per paper with hardcoded mechanisms or produce observational data only. We introduce DTCD (Datasets and Toolkit for Causal Discovery), a data generation library that produces multivariate time series with ground-truth contemporaneous and lagged adjacency matrices. Topology, mechanism, noise, observational mask, and intervention policy are independent components that compose through configuration alone. item.title: Capital Efficiency, Isolation, Risk, and Ruin in Generative AI Inference Serving Infrastructure
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Generative AI serving is an extremely capital-intensive endeavor that demands rapid, step-change improvements in capital efficiency to prevent industry wide increases in the cost of capital from limiting growth plans. Keeping pace with the economic necessities will increasingly require infrastructure providers to confront operationally-inconvenient realities of production serving, including the extreme heterogeneity of generative AI request costs. We have explored workload isolation as a foundational, fleet-level lever for increasing capital efficiency. Isolation is the practice of intelligently grouping "like" requests before execution. Rather than exposing every replica to the full heterogeneous workload distribution, isolation deliberately reshapes the workload presented to the hardware by assigning requests with different cost characteristics to different portions of the fleet. Workload isolation on its own does not make expensive requests cheaper; it prevents a costly portion of the workload from unnecessarily determining the operating point and capital efficiency of the entire fleet. It additionally lays the foundational groundwork that can serve as a launching point for comp…

item.title: Can Time Series Foundation Models Serve as Surrogates for Power Systems Dynamic Simulation?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

High-fidelity dynamic simulation is essential for scientific and engineering applications, but its computational cost limits large-scale scenario screening. We investigate the use of pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as computationally efficient surrogates to address this limitation. In-context learning and post-training strategies, including retrieval-augmented reference sample selection and physics-informed regularization, are considered in the investigation. Results are benchmarked against a traditional AI model representative of the state-of-the-art in the domain. Experiments using an open-source TSFM and data from a simulated 9-bus power system indicate promising results. Retrieval augmentation improves in-context learning performance, and fine-tuning leads to superior results compared to the traditional AI model, especially when including physics-informed regularization. The fine-tuned TSFMs achieve lower errors and improved computational costs compared to the traditional AI model, and a 563$\times$ speedup compared to the original physics-based simulation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: BiLoGo: Reducing the smoothing of localised responses in Transformer-based neural operators for sheet forming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

Trial-and-error FE simulation of sheet forming could be computationally expensive, neural-network-based learned simulators are used to accelerate design. These simulators should accurately capture localised responses, such as thinning around sharp radii or near ribs, which determine formability. Transformer-based neural operators propagate information efficiently across the mesh but tend to smooth such localised responses. This study develops BiLoGo, a Bipartite Local-Global learned simulator with an FE-guided design that connects local node-element message passing with a Transformer-based neural operator for long-range information exchange. BiLoGo has three modules: a bidirectional node-element GraphSAGE model that learns nodal-elemental coupling on a bipartite graph and predicts each quantity on its native FE entity without interpolation; a dual-stream Transformer-based neural operator that processes blank deformation and tool contact with separate token sets, preventing localised contact information from being averaged with the whole-blank state; and a fusion and element update module that combines global and local features via gated residual fusion and updates element features …

item.title: BO-Arena: An Evolving Benchmark for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimisation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

High-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (HDBO) is an increasingly crowded field with new methods proposed at every major conference, making it ever harder to answer a deceptively simple question: "Which method is currently state-of-the-art?" In this paper, we question the efficacy of benchmarking practices in the field, and find them to be systematically ineffective: multiple published works fail to benchmark against the strongest available baselines, or even include incorrect implementations of key methods. Without a shared reference implementation, such errors are difficult to detect during peer review. We therefore introduce BO-Arena, an actively maintained and extensible package providing canonical implementations of state-of-the-art algorithms, which allows researchers to develop new methods and benchmark them rigorously. Using BO-Arena, we find that what currently drives performance in HDBO is even simpler than previously thought. We use these insights to propose a new algorithm which is competitive with the state of the art on problems with many observations, without resorting to the complex GP approximations used in recent methods. item.title: Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline for Multi-Instance Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-06　分类：论文PDF

We present the Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline (ASP), an offline rollout scheduler for multi-instance asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models (LLMs). ASP jointly reduces three sources of rollout underutilization - padding bubbles from intra-minibatch length heterogeneity, skewness bubbles from long-tail outputs, and sorting bubbles from fluctuations in training-queue occupancy induced by length-sorted dispatch - through a single offline preprocessing pass. This enables efficient multi-instance rollout that overcomes the early scaling plateau of single-instance inference while smoothing the arrival of generated samples at the trainer. We integrate the scheduler into an asynchronous architecture that decouples rollout from training while keeping policy lag observable and bounded. Complete ASP improves end-to-end throughput by up to 3.22 times and reduces iteration time by up to 76.8% relative to MindSpeed-RL, while reducing iteration time by up to 62.5% relative to verl. Within ASP, scheduling reduces mean iteration time by 10.9%. ASP also scales more robustly with additional generation resources than these baselines and shows no visible convergence degradation…

item.description:

The Common Community Physics Package (CCPP) is a framework designed to simplify the exchange of physics packages between state-of-the-art atmospheric models. A core software component of CCPP is a code generator: a bespoke Python-based application th…

The Common Community Physics Package (CCPP) is a framework designed to simplify the exchange of physics packages between state-of-the-art atmospheric models. A core software component of CCPP is a code generator: a bespoke Python-based application that uses regular expressions to transform an input specification into Fortran source code. While the code generator initially provided a simple transformation capability, the demands of state-of-the-art atmospheric models have resulted in significant increases in its complexity. Furthermore, ongoing code modernisation efforts to enable GPU-based computing have placed additional demands on the code generator for which it was never designed. Domain Specific Languages (DSLs) have proven to be highly effective in High Performance Computing (HPC), offering the ability to simplify code modernisation efforts. However, traditionally the effort and specialist skills required in the development of a DSL have been a blocker to adoption. In recent years, however, there have been great advances in compiler technologies, and frameworks such as MLIR and xDSL have the potential to greatly lower this barrier to entry. In this paper, we present xDSL-CCPP,…

item.title: TopoSHAP: Shapley for Explainable and Efficient Topological Deep Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Topological deep learning (TDL) extends learning on graphs, such as molecules or social networks, to higher-order structures, such as rings in a molecule or groups in a social network. Explaining which of these structures drive a model's predictions, and which architectural components matter most for its performance, remains challenging. We introduce TopoSHAP, an efficient and general explanation framework that addresses both questions across topological domains and model architectures. TopoSHAP-cell assigns Shapley values to topological data cells and extracts compact explanations. These explanations match or outperform graph-based counterparts on GraphXAI benchmark data while running up to 112$\times$ faster. They also reveal advantageous topological feature design, leading to measured improvements in explanation recovery and predictive accuracy. On the architecture side, TopoSHAP-neighbor explains how neighborhoods contribute to model performance, and turns these evaluations into a backward-elimination search that identifies smaller, competitive architectures early in training. This is up to $11.3\times$ cheaper than traditional TDL training sweeps.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The GPU Needs an Operating System
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：AI 芯片服务模型时大量空闲——回复必须快、每步都在等内存，数学单元利用率极低——GPU 是否需要操作系统？

方法：论证 GPU 需要一个 OS：调度紧急工作、用其他有用工作填满空闲算力；给出已发布特性与更激进的研究系统方案，并说明扩展到多模型所需的编译器与新芯片特性。

关键数字：两个大型开放模型上数学单元仅忙碌约 6–11%；已发布特性以共享设计的工作可回收 1/4 GPU、真实任务回收 1/10，decode 仅慢 5%；研究系统中单个常驻 kernel 跑完整模型快于 vLLM 单请求最优，共享 GPU 时减速低于 2%。

为什么值得看：从利用率视角重构 GPU 软件栈的纲领性观点，推理系统设计值得参考。

item.title: Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill/decode 分离（P/D）之外，把 decode 再拆成 attention/FFN 分离（AFD）增加了通信与部署约束——未来模型与加速器路线下还值不值？

方法：提出 SiliconForge 校准模型，独立变化服务分解与硬件分配；在四个模型方向、四类加速器、两种互连上对比 P/D 与 P/D+AFD，用相同流水线重叠规则与功耗预算联合优化。

关键数字：主对比显示 AFD 在 SLO goodput/kW 上无稳健的部署级优势；最大 AFD 领先来自多容纳一个 prefill 副本而非更高效的 decode 池；KV-heavy 方向在专家池横跨多个小型 scale-up 域时 AFD 名义领先。

为什么值得看：用可复现的校准模型回答「是否拆分 decode」的基础设施决策，前瞻性规划直接可用。

原文：Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators

item.title: Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模拟 CIM 扩展到更多芯片（chiplet）时，基于局部算子成本与聚合通信的抽象掩盖了权重映射拓扑的影响——如何量化并利用这一设计维度？

方法：开发相位分析量化映射拓扑对系统性能的影响强度与映射优化可转化的延迟收益；提出 Isobar 仿真平台，集成 CIM 分解、异构执行与资源建模，经硅片实测与周期精确仿真验证。

关键数字：Gemma-7B prefill 上 Isobar 引导映射比最强基线降低通信时间 23.3%、端到端延迟 18.6%；系统级建模显示扩展到数千 die 时模拟 CIM 仍保持相对 GPU 的能效优势。

为什么值得看：首个把拓扑感知映射做成可搜索设计维度的模拟 CIM 平台，大模型部署选型有据可依。

原文：Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping

发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模拟 CIM 扩展到更多芯片（chiplet）时，基于局部算子成本与聚合通信的抽象掩盖了权重映射拓扑的影响——如何量化并利用这一设计维度？

方法：开发相位分析量化映射拓扑对系统性能的影响强度与映射优化可转化的延迟收益；提出 Isobar 仿真平台，集成 CIM 分解、异构执行与资源建模，经硅片实测与周期精确仿真验证。

关键数字：Gemma-7B prefill 上 Isobar 引导映射比最强基线降低通信时间 23.3%、端到端延迟 18.6%；系统级建模显示扩展到数千 die 时模拟 CIM 仍保持相对 GPU 的能效优势。

为什么值得看：首个把拓扑感知映射做成可搜索设计维度的模拟 CIM 平台，大模型部署选型有据可依。

原文：Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping

item.title: SAFTAC: Simulation-Augmented Fine-Tuning of Open-Source LLMs for Analog Circuit Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Circuit design for analog integrated circuits (ICs) is challenging because circuit topology, device sizing, and circuit performance are tightly coupled. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods either rely on inference-time correction around frozen models or train on limited circuit types without directly using simulation outcomes as training signals. A key bottleneck is that existing datasets do not provide sufficient task information for training LLMs on end-to-end specification-conditioned design. To fill this gap, we first construct a large-scale simulation-grounded dataset with 8,626 design tasks across 10 different types of analog circuits, where each task includes a textual description, labeled I/O ports, loading condition, target specifications, a testbench, and a reference netlist. Using this dataset, we present SAFTAC, a simulation-augmented fine-tuning framework that trains LLMs to generate and revise analog circuit design. SAFTAC combines three-stage supervised fine-tuning, which progressively builds the capabilities required for analog circuit design and feedback-guided correction, with simulation feedback-augmented reinforcement fine-tuning, which further opt…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 直接生成可综合 HLS-C 时，多轮工具反馈与可复用 HLS 知识难以转成有效修订——如何提升端到端生成成功率？

方法：提出 MementoHLS，可执行可证伪的双记忆引导修复框架：ERCL 把跨任务 HLS 知识转为证据门控修复动作，RFL 把任务内修复历史转为轨迹证据抑制无效路径；Same-Candidate Reviewer 把解析/编译/测试台/综合结果绑定到对应候选，Single-Commit Arbiter 每轮最多提交一个候选。

关键数字：94 个 HLS-Eval 与 170 个 Bench4HLS 任务上，TB∧Synth pass@1/pass@5 从 41.7%/57.4% 提升至 58.9%/68.1%（HLS-Eval），从 15.5%/32.9% 提升至 32.4%/50.6%（Bench4HLS）。

为什么值得看：HLS 生成端到端可靠性提升显著，证据绑定机制避免错误归因，工程价值直接。

原文：Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation

item.title: ResServe: Accurate and Efficient FP4 LLM Inference with Residue Compensation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：FP4 量化降低 LLM 推理成本但损害任务质量，提高精度计算又吃掉效率收益——能否利用解码阶段空闲算力低成本恢复精度？

方法：ResServe 在 FP4 激活基座之上叠加 FP4 量化的残差（表示量化丢失的信息），利用解码常见窄矩阵计算留下的空闲硬件容量计算残差贡献，片内合并结果、避免额外传输；对线性层与 decode attention 应用，输入 prompt 处理用选择性补偿控制额外开销。

关键数字：NVIDIA B200 上，补偿后的 NVFP4 线性核在少行操作下保持接近未补偿执行的延迟；相对 W4A4 请求延迟最多增加 3.4%，相对 W4A8 请求延迟降低 22.4–53.3%；五个模型上代码生成准确率相对同格式未补偿推理平均提升 15.04%（NVFP4）与 53.57%（MXFP4）。

为什么值得看：FP4 推理"精度-效率"两全的新机制，量化推理部署可直接采用。

item.title: ReKV: Overlapping Quantized KV Transfer and Suffix Recomputation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：prefill-decode 分离中 KV cache 在 worker 间传递是首 token 前的关键延迟——只压缩或只重算都不够，能否在传输的同时重建后缀？

方法：ReKV 传输量化前缀 KV cache 加一个 BF16 边界状态，前缀在途时在 decode worker 上重建连续后缀；传输层数与精度、重算层数可联合选择。

关键数字：跨节点 H100 合成基准中，满足质量标准的 Q8 配置将 8K handoff 延迟相对 BF16 传输降低 2.36×（Qwen2.5-7B）、2.84×（Qwen2.5-3B）、3.65×（Qwen3-8B），并快于最优的纯传输或纯重算；真实权重 BF16 重算实验将 prefill-to-token-return 时间降低 1.16–1.63×。

为什么值得看：把压缩与重算结合并重叠执行，优于任一单独手段，分布式 LLM 推理直接受益。

item.title: Quantum Advantage in Local Certification of Graph Properties
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Local certification allows network vertices to verify global properties using certificates from an untrusted prover and communication with their neighbors. Its complexity is the maximum certificate size at any vertex. Fraigniaud et al. (ITCS 2021) in…

Local certification allows network vertices to verify global properties using certificates from an untrusted prover and communication with their neighbors. Its complexity is the maximum certificate size at any vertex. Fraigniaud et al. (ITCS 2021) introduced the distributed quantum Merlin-Arthur (dQMA) model and proved an exponential quantum advantage for distributed equality, measured in input-string length. We resolve a question of Hasegawa, Kundu, and Nishimura (PODC 2024) by establishing unconditional exponential and polynomial quantum advantages for graph properties, which depend only on network topology, with complexity measured in the number $n$ of vertices. For every fixed integer $μ\ge 1$, we construct a graph property admitting a one-round dQMA protocol with $O(μ\log n)$-qubit certificates and messages, whereas every $μ$-round distributed Merlin-Arthur (dMA) protocol requires $Ω(n/(μ\log^2 n))$-bit certificates. We also give a one-round dQMA protocol for graph symmetry, the existence of a nontrivial automorphism, with $\widetilde{O}(n^{5/3})$-qubit certificates. This yields a polynomial advantage over one-round dMA protocols, for which an $Ω(n^2)$-bit certificate lower bo…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Precision - Preserving Subtensor Inference for a 22B Joint Audio - Video Generator under a Fixed GPU Working Set
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：整块 offloading 需要每个传输块塞进 GPU 预算，大模型在固定显存下如何保持精度地推理？

方法：提出 PSI（Precision-Preserving Subtensor Inference），固定 arena 运行时：子块权重流式传输 + 中间状态独立管理，针对 BF16 LTX-2.5 22B 音视频联合 transformer；分区算子保持稠密实算术构造，并分离资源占用、传输正确性与数值保真控制。

关键数字：RTX A6000 九个匹配 prompt 下峰值内存从 8,578 降至 360 MiB；十一次 transformer 调用平均耗时 247.11→349.00 s；托管 arena 仅 80 MiB；3 GiB 显存上限下原生生成与 FLASH 路径均成功；FFN 复用降低平均块耗时 4.0%。

为什么值得看：把大模型 offload 推理压到固定 3 GiB 显存仍保精度，边缘与受限环境直接受益。

原文：Precision - Preserving Subtensor Inference for a 22B Joint Audio - Video Generator under a Fixed GPU Working Set

item.title: Post-Quantum Authentication of IoT Data on Ethereum: Signatures, the Calldata Floor, and Device-Signed Merkle Roots
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Field devices deployed today will still be producing records when quantum computers may break their signatures, so systems that anchor IoT data on blockchains need a post-quantum (PQ) authentication path now. We measure its cost on Ethereum under the…

Field devices deployed today will still be producing records when quantum computers may break their signatures, so systems that anchor IoT data on blockchains need a post-quantum (PQ) authentication path now. We measure its cost on Ethereum under the current execution rules, including the EIP-7623 calldata floor and the EIP-7825 transaction cap, and under the calldata repricing scheduled for the Glamsterdam upgrade. We combine device-side measurements of ML-DSA, Falcon, SLH-DSA, LMS and XMSS, reproduced costs of open-source Solidity verifiers, a new standard-compliant LMS/HSS verifier for SHA-256 and SHA-256/192, and complete transactions on an Osaka-rule EVM, priced with today's verifiers and with proposed precompiles. Three results stand out. Signing every record costs 8.7 times as much as ECDSA even with an ML-DSA precompile, because the calldata floor rather than verification sets the price. When each device signs a Merkle root over 100 records, a standard LMS verifier available today costs about 3,350 gas per record, against 245 gas for ECDSA in the same design, and it is unaffected by the scheduled repricing, which raises floor-bound designs by up to 1.9 times. item.title: Patching the Blind Spots: Reversible LLM Rule Overlay for Frozen Fraud Detectors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

In industrial tabular fraud classification, gradient-boosted trees remain state-of-the-art, but even a well-trained model has blind spots, and retraining the deployed model is not always safe. We propose a framework that patches such a model without modifying it: LLMs propose rules anchored on features the model underweights by SHAP, and the resulting noisy pool is screened for empirical support and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay that runs at the production cut-off. Single-LLM benefit is high-variance and inverts between datasets, so we pool three diverse backbones by equal-weight logit averaging, trading peak gain for a bounded worst case. On a real-world e-commerce fraud detector trained on selection-biased data, continued training regresses even when carefully tuned, whereas the overlay gains on average +2.26% recall at equal precision ($Δ$R@P) and +1.60% precision at equal recall ($Δ$P@R) over production cut-offs spanning 30-57% precision and 23-63% recall. On a public benchmark of seven designed bias-shift variants it raises $Δ$P@R on every variant and keeps $Δ$R@P near neutral. Each amendment is a readable predicate naming the fraud pattern it covers…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大集群算力密度上升，网络通信越来越限制系统性能；GPU 发起通信要低开销提交，但 GDR 控制面仍依赖 CPU、IBGDA 要 GPU 组装 WQE 消耗 SM 与带宽——怎么办？

方法：OpenRDMA 开源多路径可靠 RDMA 传输架构：最小 GPU doorbell（GPU 发 8 字节 token，FPGA NIC 从预配置上下文重建完整 WQE）；基于 MRC 支持逐包多路径与乱序到达，选择性重传、有序 DMA 放置与 GPU 可见标志轮询保证可靠交付；硬件-软件协同重传，NIC 管快速数据传输、CPU 管超时检测与恢复策略。

关键数字：正文给出架构与关键硬件组件描述，FPGA 原型实现进行中，尚无实测性能数字。

为什么值得看：把 WQE 装配移出 GPU、控制面留在 CPU，是 GPU 原生通信路径的务实新架构，开源可跟进。

原文：OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：大集群算力密度上升，网络通信越来越限制系统性能；GPU 发起通信要低开销提交，但 GDR 控制面仍依赖 CPU、IBGDA 要 GPU 组装 WQE 消耗 SM 与带宽——怎么办？

方法：OpenRDMA 开源多路径可靠 RDMA 传输架构：最小 GPU doorbell（GPU 发 8 字节 token，FPGA NIC 从预配置上下文重建完整 WQE）；基于 MRC 支持逐包多路径与乱序到达，选择性重传、有序 DMA 放置与 GPU 可见标志轮询保证可靠交付；硬件-软件协同重传，NIC 管快速数据传输、CPU 管超时检测与恢复策略。

关键数字：正文给出架构与关键硬件组件描述，FPGA 原型实现进行中，尚无实测性能数字。

为什么值得看：把 WQE 装配移出 GPU、控制面留在 CPU，是 GPU 原生通信路径的务实新架构，开源可跟进。

原文：OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture

item.title: On the Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models: A Few Gradient Signs Are All You Need
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

The limited supervision available for the few-shot adaptation of vision-language models makes gradient estimation particularly noisy. We find that the gradient magnitudes are severely miscalibrated, while the signs of a small top-magnitude subset remain informative. This motivates SignSparseSGD and DynSignSparseSGD, two state-free optimizers that use gradient magnitudes only to select where to update and fixed-magnitude signs to decide how to update. The static variant fixes the support after the first minibatch. The dynamic variant refreshes it at every step. Across 11 datasets, three CLIP backbones, and five shot levels, the proposed methods are competitive with or outperform parameter-efficient and optimization-based baselines on average, while exhibiting markedly lower sensitivity to long training schedules. They introduce no task-specific modules, maintain no first- or second-moment optimizer states, and use one shared configuration across datasets, backbones, and shot levels. Our code is included in the supplementary materials and will be released upon publication.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Not All Misalignment Is Alike: A Decomposed Benchmark for Emergent Misalignment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Emergent misalignment (EM), in which fine-tuning on a narrow task induces misaligned behaviour on unrelated prompts, has been demonstrated across a wide range of datasets, model families, and training setups. Yet, most studies continue to rely on the evaluation approach introduced in the original EM paper, producing rates that are sensitive to the small set of evaluation questions used, the choice of judge, and the thresholds applied. These evaluations can also conflate misalignment with capability loss and offer little insight into the specific ways misalignment manifests. Differences in datasets, models, and fine-tuning configurations further make findings difficult to compare across studies. We introduce EMERGE, a decomposed benchmark that tracks changes in eight distinct misaligned behaviours from base to fine-tuned models. It evaluates these behaviours on out-of-domain prompts against matched benign controls and tracks capability, coherence, and refusal to account for potential confounders. Applying EMERGE to 8 open-weight models and 13 fine-tuning datasets, we find that models with similar broad misalignment rates can exhibit very different behavioural profiles that a single …

item.title: MotionBench-XAI: Benchmarking What Shapes Shapley Explanations in Spatiotemporal Machine Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Predicting outcomes from spatiotemporal data, such as assessing Parkinson's severity from human motion, often requires explainability in addition to accuracy. Practitioners need to know what drove the prediction, whether it be spatial (a body joint), temporal (a specific window), or both. Shapley values are attributions computed by treating input features as players in a cooperative game and measuring how the model output changes as coalitions of players are removed. Computing them involves choosing what counts as players, how absent players are imputed, and how the game is evaluated. How these choices affect explanation quality is poorly understood for spatiotemporal data, and real data carries no ground-truth attributions to check against. We present MotionBench-XAI, a benchmark built on i) five synthetic spatiotemporal datasets with exact ground-truth Shapley values, ii) three real datasets across clinical gait, electrocardiogram, and audio, iii) ten attribution methods across three player sets, and iv) three trained architectures. We show that grouping features into players, across time, space, or both, matters more than the choice of imputer. Generative imputers improve explan…

We present a novel approach for model checking fault-tolerant distributed algorithms: instead of building large, monolithic algorithm models, we propose a modular approach where the user decomposes the algorithm into modules, verifies them individually, and replaces them with a synchronous abstraction. To enable our technique, we introduce a new system model that combines aspects of threshold automata and global synchronization protocols. We investigate the expressiveness of our new model, and present a (bounded) model checking procedure as well as a method for checking the correctness of the abstraction step. item.title: Minimum-Sufficient Knowledge and Computation for Wind Energy Predictive Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Resource-constrained cyber-physical decision systems often apply fixed sensing, knowledge, and computational pipelines despite state-dependent information needs. We introduce Minimum-Sufficient Knowledge and Computation (MSKC), a resource-aware computing principle: select the least-costly route meeting decision-risk and deployment constraints, escalating only when cheaper routes are insufficient. As proof of concept, we isolate adaptive knowledge routing, the decision underlying Knowledge-Guided Machine Learning (KGML), which conventionally injects external knowledge unconditionally rather than only where needed. We instantiate this for wind ramp-event predictive analysis, an edge-oriented decision-support task, evaluating local, relational, and physics-informed routes with a state-aware gate on publicly available real data from two wind farms. We establish conditions for feasibility preservation, cost dominance, and strict expected savings over always-on routing. At a 35.9% relational-knowledge injection rate, adaptive routing is statistically indistinguishable from always-on injection on the reported metrics while reducing knowledge calls by 64%, supporting sustainable, Green-IT-…

item.title: MEDALLION: Manifold Embedding Distillation and Attributions for Low-dimensional Latent InterpretatiON
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Dimensionality reduction is widely used to visualize high-dimensional data and guide scientific discovery, yet interpreting which original features contribute to low-dimensional representations remains challenging, particularly for black-box methods such as t-SNE and UMAP. We introduce \textbf{MEDALLION} (Manifold Embedding Distillation and Attributions for Low-dimensional Latent InterpretatiON), a novel framework for interpreting low-dimensional embeddings through knowledge distillation and neural feature attribution. MEDALLION distills any given embedding with a neural encoder which we explain via a broad range of existing neural feature attribution methods. Through experiments on MNIST and applications in single-cell transcriptomics, we show MEDALLION provides informative feature attributions that cast additional insights into the underlying embedding and compare its performance with existing interpretability approaches.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: How Small Can We Go? Calibrating Activation-Cache Compression for SAE Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

To train a sparse autoencoder (SAE), you need a massive cache of model activations. We look into the effects that compression has on an SAE in two ways: we keep the original fp32-trained SAE and pass the compressed cache into the same SAE to see how many feature activations stay the same (the frozen-SAE test), and we retrain an SAE on the compressed cache and see how many of the original features still exist (the retraining test). We found that in the retraining test, there is no clear scale for retained features. On a GPT-2 cache, rounding everything to fp16 keeps 60.6% of features, but changing one value in a million by the smallest step fp32 allows (a change eight orders of magnitude smaller) keeps only 70.5%. Meanwhile, changing the random seed keeps 23.0%. For the frozen-SAE test, the frozen SAE's correlation with the original increases in order of how precise the codecs are, but plain $L_2$ distance gives nearly the same ordering. We also see the same frozen reading correspond to different percentages retained at different sites. This leaves the question of the right measurement. We build one by calibrating: retraining on identical bytes sets the ceiling, and a reseed sets th…

item.title: Higher Order Component Attribution via Learned Surrogates in High Energy Physics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Experimental High Energy Physics (HEP) has adopted the transformer architecture for identification of jets, particularly the state-of-the-art Particle Transformer (ParT) which injects explicit information about particle correlations into the attention mechanism. While able to achieve state-of-the-art results in accuracy, interpretability to its effectiveness has been limited. In this paper we propose component attribution methods using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that directly tie back to the physical descriptors of jets, to probe whether mechanisms such as Multi-Head Attention (MHA), or the ParT architecture, are able to learn these as discriminating features.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: HeteroTask: Multi-Variant Task Scheduling and Execution on Distributed Heterogeneous Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Heterogeneous systems that combine CPUs and GPUs across multiple servers offer substantial compute capability but complicate scheduling. For DAG-based applications with multiple task implementations, effective execution requires coordinating variant selection, device placement, and data movement. Offline planning can exploit global dependency information, yet plans derived from isolated kernel profiles may diverge from execution because of runtime overheads. We introduce HeteroTask, a framework integrating kernel-wise profiling, PEFT-based multi-variant planning, host-buffer lifetime modeling, and schedule-driven MPI execution. A Bayesian-optimization loop calibrates empirical overhead corrections for repeated, fixed-DAG workflows on exclusively allocated nodes. We evaluate five benchmark and workflow-derived applications on up to six 8-GPU nodes. On two 8-GPU nodes, HeteroTask reduces application-level completion time by 19.7-72.1% relative to the compared StarPU implementations. For Canny Edge Detection, calibration reduces task-window makespan by 25.0% relative to planning without overhead corrections. Combined with CPU/GPU variant selection, calibration reduces it by 58.9% rela…

item.title: Enabling Retraining-Free Accurate Inference in Analog Compute in Memory Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模拟存内计算（CIM）加速器的转换器/器件误差使预训练模型无法直接使用，硬件感知重训练成本高——能否免重训练实现精确推理？

方法：低成本的共享校准实现免重训练的精确推理：核心观察是模拟误差取决于每层在阵列上的表示，且该表示可在离线改变而不改变计算——中心化输入并施加为模拟阵列设计的 Hadamard 旋转，保持共享参考误差分散并把输入混合限制在阵列内。

关键数字：跨 CNN、ViT 与最大 14B 的 LLM（PCM 与 ReRAM）上，视觉模型与更大 LLM 逼近浮点精度几个点以内；ReRAM 6-bit ADC 下 ViT-B/16 从 37.4% 恢复到 82.9%，Phi-4 从 27.0% 恢复到 72.2%，均在浮点精度 2.2 点以内。

为什么值得看：存算一体推理免重训练的实用路径，大幅降低模拟阵列部署成本。

item.title: Dual-Stream LLM-Guided Reward Design for Reject-Inference-Aware Reinforcement Learning in E-Commerce Payment Fraud Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Production fraud-detection models learn from a censored slice of their own traffic: transactions a legacy system blocked never receive fraud labels, so models train on a biased, approved-only distribution. We extend LLM-guided reward design, the framework of Qu et al. (2025) in which an LLM evolves the reward of a two-step REINFORCE fraud-blocking policy, to attack this reject-inference problem inside the reward. A single LLM designs a dual-stream reward: stream 1 applies the standard dollar-weighted precision objective to labeled transactions; stream 2 scores legacy-blocked, unlabeled transactions by contrasting the newest gradient-boosted risk signal against the legacy scores that drove the original block. Rather than prescribe which signals matter, we expose a superset of evidence and let the LLM decide for itself which to use, guided by evaluation feedback alone; because it writes the reward as code, that choice is directly auditable. On a held-out four-month out-of-time test, the dual-stream agent beats the prior labeled-only agent at every target recall, by +4.7, +2.4 and +3.0 points of dollar-weighted precision at 80%, 85% and 90% recall, and the production baseline by +6.8 …

item.title: Characterizing CUDA Locality Domains on Blackwell GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Blackwell/Rubin 多 die 扩展下跨 die 通信与数据放置的延迟代价尚不清楚——CUDA 13.4 的 Locality Domain（LD）能否缓解？

方法：单节点 8 张 B300 上系统评测 LD 三方面：内存管理与访问、计算、通信；做 die 感知适配并集成常用库与工具。

关键数字：NCCL 2.32.3（AllGather）提速最高 43.5%、nvbandwidth（DtoD）111.3%、DeepGEMM（EP）37%；超过 32MB 分配有不可忽略的 LD 分配开销（barrier 与 TLB 失效），已向 NVIDIA 提交驱动修复，开销可降 7x–10x 且无需用户改代码。

为什么值得看：首份 Blackwell LD 特性实测报告，既给提速路径也指出分配开销与修复方案。

原文：Characterizing CUDA Locality Domains on Blackwell GPUs
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

方法：单节点 8 张 B300 上系统评测 LD 三方面：内存管理与访问、计算、通信；做 die 感知适配并集成常用库与工具。

关键数字：NCCL 2.32.3（AllGather）提速最高 43.5%、nvbandwidth（DtoD）111.3%、DeepGEMM（EP）37%；超过 32MB 分配有不可忽略的 LD 分配开销（barrier 与 TLB 失效），已向 NVIDIA 提交驱动修复，开销可降 7x–10x 且无需用户改代码。

为什么值得看：首份 Blackwell LD 特性实测报告，既给提速路径也指出分配开销与修复方案。

item.title: CPU Micro-Architectural Characteristic Sensitivity Study on CPU-Side Agentic Task Latency
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

We perform a novel study of CPU micro-architectural characteristics on how they affect agentic AI CPU side latency. Small enterprises and individual users looking to reduce costs and seeking data privacy benefit from running agents locally, motivating an investigation into the optimal performance characteristics of an edge CPU to improve user experience. We investigate the relationship between CPU core frequency, CPU uncore frequency, active physical cores, and symmetric multi threading with agentic task latency in single and multi agent configurations. Across eight experiments on an Intel edge CPU, we find that P-core frequency produces the largest median latency improvement among the evaluated parameters. Increasing P-core frequency from 2.5 to 5.5 GHz yields a 1.154$\times$ speedup for a single agent and a 1.341$\times$ speedup for eight concurrent agents. We are the first to characterize hardware micro-architectural relationships on single and multi agent configurations with TerminalBench; we also provide an open source framework and dataset for repeatable CPU side latency agentic benchmarking.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Benchmarking Machine Learning for Chaotic Three-Body Dynamics in Astrophysics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning (ML) and generative AI have recently made impressive progress in understanding physics. We explore a hierarchy of prediction problems stemming from chaotic three-body systems and benchmark existing ML approaches, including general-purpose prediction algorithms and those that build on top of foundational physics models. We first simulate the trajectories of triple systems near the critical boundary of stable/unstable initial conditions. We then design a hierarchy of learning tasks, focusing mainly on two broad problems: stability prediction and trajectory prediction. The former classifies whether a given triple system has diverged or not up to a specific horizon, while the latter predicts the exact trajectory, both given suitable input features. We benchmark a range of ML approaches, from simple regression methods to state-of-the-art foundational physics models, across these tasks, and compare them against astrophysical methods such as the Mardling-Aarseth stability criterion. Our experiments reveal a clear order of task difficulties in chaotic three-body dynamics: early dynamics enable strong stability prediction, while precise long-horizon trajectory forecasting r…

item.title: AutoParallel: Composable, PyTorch-Native Automatic Parallelism for Production Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生产 PyTorch 训练依赖手写并行方案，模型架构、负载与硬件拓扑多样时难以适配——能否自动联合搜索并行化选择？

方法：AutoParallel，PyTorch 原生的分布式训练规划器：跨训练计算联合搜索并行化选择，输出普通 PyTorch 程序（无需独立执行运行时），可与模型特定分布式代码组合，计划可检查、可重放。

关键数字：在最高 4 维 mesh、128 张 NVIDIA H100 上的 dense/混合/MoE 模型中，多数配置匹配或超过专家手写 TorchTitan 方案，吞吐最高提升 18.3%，并能发现统一专家方案无法表达的并行计划。

为什么值得看：训练并行策略自动化的生产级落地，直接对接 PyTorch 编译与训练栈。

item.title: All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Operator learning seeks to approximate function-to-function maps in a way that remains stable when the input discretization changes, a property sometimes called "discretization invariance". We consider a quantitative refinement of this idea, called $\textit{uniform discretization stability}$, which builds on a common representation of input functions and their discretizations as probability measures and provides a Hölder bound relating output changes to the Wasserstein distance between these measures. Our main result is a representation theorem showing all uniformly discretization stable operators can be written exactly as a $\textit{stable Markov kernel network}$---an abstract architecture that is a joint generalization of transformers, Fourier neural operators (FNO), Flowers, and other successful learned operators. Our representation theorem characterizes a design space for discretization-stable operator learning; designing new architectures becomes a question of which parts of a Markov kernel network to parameterize, and how. We further show that the read kernels of these networks can be realized as solutions of regularized variational problems, with particular choices of costs …

item.title: A Synchronized Tri-Modality Wireless System for Multi-Point Non-Contact Cardiac Monitoring
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-05　分类：论文PDF

Cardiac physiological monitoring is fundamental to evaluating cardiovascular health and diagnosing related diseases. Non-contact radar sensing can capture chest-wall vibrations with spatial specificity, enabling localized physiological monitoring and…

Cardiac physiological monitoring is fundamental to evaluating cardiovascular health and diagnosing related diseases. Non-contact radar sensing can capture chest-wall vibrations with spatial specificity, enabling localized physiological monitoring and cardiac assessment. Progress, however, has been limited by the absence of a reliable, research-grade hardware platform for rigorous validation of radar-based methods. Prior systems typically pair radar, namely Doppler cardiography (DCG), with only electrocardiography (ECG) or other coarse references, providing no direct mechanical ground truth and thus constraining fine-grained evaluation of radar outputs. We present a tri-modality wireless system that integrates ECG, seismocardiography (SCG), and DCG under a unified acquisition and control framework for time-aligned recording and analysis. The tri-modality system combines miniaturized wearable ECG/SCG modules with a high-resolution mmWave radar module, supporting spatially resolved sensing and subsequent feature extraction. To our knowledge, this is the first integrated ECG--SCG--DCG hardware system for comprehensive cardiac monitoring; it enables multi-point thoracic acquisition, ach…

item.title: vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 模型分布式部署中，静态专家放置与动态路由冲突导致严重负载不均衡；主机 DRAM 卸载可缓解，但现有 offloading 工作忽视运行期 H2D 传输与共享 PCIe 拓扑的耦合影响、以及 DRAM 大规模使用的系统级内存开销。

方法：提出 vExpert，把 DRAM 卸载从部分驻留转向全冗余的虚拟化专家存储：首个联合刻画 H2D 延迟、PCIe 争用与负载不均衡的系统性能模型；轻量分配器在运行期把物理专家动态映射到虚拟槽位；分离式管理器降低多进程环境内存开销。

关键数字：DeepSeek-V3.1 在 8 节点 H100 集群上，负载均衡比最多提升 55%，端到端加速 1.2x。

为什么值得看：直面分布式 MoE 推理的负载失衡痛点，用虚拟化专家存储给出系统性解法，落地数字扎实。

原文：vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference

item.title: flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 解码的集体通信中，就绪同步与数据搬运分离导致额外屏障开销——能否把两者融合，让数据块自带就绪证据、免去跨 GPU 屏障？

方法：提出 flash-comm：自同步传输让每个数据块携带就绪证据，接收方直接校验所需块；基于代价的协议选择器按消息大小与 GPU 数适配就绪编码；并把传输顺序与归约顺序解耦，保证异步到达下跨 GPU 结果一致。

关键数字：八卡 NVIDIA B300 上 all-reduce 延迟中位降 28.8%、最高 43.7%（对比 SOTA 的 custom AR v2）；端到端解码每输出 token 时间（TPOT）降 1.7%~6.8%；all-gather 延迟中位降 23.8%、最高 58.9%。

为什么值得看：all-reduce 占基线解码时间 11.4%，flash-comm 把该部分优化到接近理论上限，并给出独立 all-gather 收益，通信库设计值得借鉴。

原文：flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding

item.title: Who Pays for the Knowledge Models Copy? Model Collapse as Rogers' Paradox
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Generative models trained on the output of earlier models lose knowledge across generations, rare knowledge first. The remedies that work all bring in information from outside the

Generative models trained on the output of earlier models lose knowledge across generations, rare knowledge first. The remedies that work all bring in information from outside the loop, and the theory of model collapse treats that supply as given: a fixed archive, drawn from a fixed distribution. We argue that the supply is the problem, and that cultural evolution has the theory of it. We read model collapse as Rogers' paradox: a population that comes to rely on copying ends up no better off than one that never copied, because copies go stale unless someone keeps learning for themselves. We test the identification in three steps. First, Rogers' model, fitted only to fully synthetic training, predicts to within a few percentage points how much rare knowledge language models, from word trigrams to a pretrained transformer, retain under other mixtures of fresh data. Second, when the world itself changes, a lineage that copies its own past needs more fresh data to keep up the faster the world changes, as Rogers' model says it must and as analyses that assume a fixed target cannot; a lineage that restarts every generation from fixed pretrained weights is largely insulated, because those…

item.title: Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from r

Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampl

While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Weaver: Unlocking Blockchain Transaction Parallelism through State-Decoupled Symbolic Execution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Transaction execution remains a major performance bottleneck in blockchains. Existing parallel execution engines are still blocked by slow state accesses on each transaction's crit

Transaction execution remains a major performance bottleneck in blockchains. Existing parallel execution engines are still blocked by slow state accesses on each transaction's critical path, creating a hidden loss of parallelism. This paper presents Weaver, a state-decoupled transaction processing paradigm that enables execution flow to proceed in the absence of concrete state values. Weaver represents states as lightweight symbolic references and records subsequent computation as symbolic expressions while concrete values are fetched on the fly. To handle state-dependent control flow, Weaver predicts the most likely branch direction through hierarchical symbolic pattern matching. Weaver further introduces expression-granular scheduling that evaluates each symbolic expression as soon as its state dependencies are resolved, rather than waiting for the transaction's entire read set, fully exploiting fine-grained intra-transaction parallelism. Evaluation on real Ethereum blocks and synthetic workloads spanning four representative dApps shows that Weaver delivers 41%-63% higher throughput than state-of-the-art parallel execution engines and up to 7.5 times the throughput of serial exec…

item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Transaction execution remains a major performance bottleneck in blockchains. Existing parallel execution engines are still blocked by slow state accesses on each transaction's crit

Transaction execution remains a major performance bottleneck in blockchains. Existing parallel execution engines are still blocked by slow state accesses on each transaction's critical path, creating a hidden loss of parallelism. This paper presents Weaver, a state-decoupled transaction processing paradigm that enables execution flow to proceed in the absence of concrete state values. Weaver represents states as lightweight symbolic references and records subsequent computation as symbolic expressions while concrete values are fetched on the fly. To handle state-dependent control flow, Weaver predicts the most likely branch direction through hierarchical symbolic pattern matching. Weaver further introduces expression-granular scheduling that evaluates each symbolic expression as soon as its state dependencies are resolved, rather than waiting for the transaction's entire read set, fully exploiting fine-grained intra-transaction parallelism. Evaluation on real Ethereum blocks and synthetic workloads spanning four representative dApps shows that Weaver delivers 41%-63% higher throughput than state-of-the-art parallel execution engines and up to 7.5 times the throughput of serial exec…

item.title: Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored

Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. A Rademacher-complexity analysis further shows that the estimation term is of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T/n})$, rather than linear in $T$, due to predictor sharing under a uniform capacity control on the shared class. item.title: The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LoRA 用紧凑学习更新适配冻结语言模型，但 adapter 的 rank、参数量或数值重建误差都不能直接说明「保持已习得行为需要多少比特」——如何定义微调所需的有用信息量？

方法：定义可操作的 behavioral rate R*：压缩 adapter 重载回冻结基座模型后仍保留固定比例微调收益的最小序列化大小；在 LoRA 微调实验中跨数据集、跨基座模型测量，并用数据上测得的 correction spectra 排名。

关键数字：故意损坏数据集训练的 adapter 远低于冻结模型，压缩后反超（GSM8K 上 23.7%~82.9%，对比冻结 Qwen2.5-7B 的 77.6%）；压缩后的损坏 adapter 在更难数学上保留基座 97% 准确率，干净微调仅 44%。

为什么值得看：压缩不仅是体积优化，还有过滤损坏的噪声抑制效应，且微调可压缩性是「数据集-接收者」配对属性——对微调与压缩研究都是新视角。

原文：The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information

item.title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure

Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequence…

item.title: TauLang: A Language and Compiler for Space-Time Programming on Statically Scheduled Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PL　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Groq TSP 这类静态调度加速器去掉了缓存、仲裁器与硬件调度器，编译器必须固定每个操作的精确 slice 与发射周期——「何时运行」成为正确性条件，现有 kernel 语言无法表达显式时间，如何编程这类机器？

方法：提出 TauLang，把时间作为程序的一等公民：程序员用参数化显式时间调度操作、循环与组合 kernel；在定时中间表示 TauIR 中代数校验显式时间，再用整数线性规划联合求解张量放置与周期调度，用显式时间把相连操作分组为 timing cluster 剪枝搜索空间。

关键数字：在 TSP 类机器的周期精确模型上，联合搜索对十个 kernel 相对空间优先流程取得 1.40x 延迟加速；少量显式时间钉住即可把延迟控制在无定时调度一个周期内，并把联合搜索扩展到 1,636 个 GEMM 块（无定时搜索在 32 块即无解）。

为什么值得看：把时间显式化进语言与编译器，为静态调度加速器提供了首个可编程路径，值得关注。

原文：TauLang: A Language and Compiler for Space-Time Programming on Statically Scheduled Accelerators

item.title: Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention 等门控 delta 线性注意力层为 GPU 调优（小 tensor-core tile + 快速向量寄存器），直接移植到 TPU 会让每个矩阵 tile 空一半、瓶颈卡在向量运算——如何围绕 TPU 的 256x256 脉动矩阵单元重构？

方法：提出 Systolic Linear Attention（SLA）：把 key 加宽到 256 配分组 value head、把衰减门分组为四个 64 通道 tile、用块矩阵乘积在单个融合 kernel 内完成 chunk solve，把整个层重塑到矩阵单元上。

关键数字：TPU v7x 上完整 SLA-R4 层比开源 Tokamax KDA kernel 快 1.6x~2.5x（精确 chunk 求逆时 1.4x~2.4x）；2048 芯片 v7x 预训练研究中 6.5B~63.1B 稀疏 MoE 模型训练快 11%~24%，困惑度相当或略低。

为什么值得看：为 TPU 定制线性注意力的软硬协同设计，直接给出训练侧提速证据，对 TPU 用户有实操价值。

原文：Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs

item.title: Symmetry Breaking at the Edge of Stability via Central Flow Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gr

Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gradient descent need not preserve these laws, particularly at the edge of stability (EOS), where the iterates oscillate around a smoother trajectory, which can be described by the central flow dynamics (Cohen et al., 2025). We study how gradient flow conservation laws evolve under the central flow description of this regime. We show that the curvature correction induces a finite-dimensional drift determined by the oscillation covariance along critical parameter directions. We thus take the first steps to analyse which conservation laws remain and are broken at the EOS according to the central flow dynamics by analysing a scalar two-layer model, two-layer matrix factorisation, and a two-layer ReLU network, where the known conservation laws are shown to be complete (Marcotte et al., 2023).

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Short-Term Forecasting of Heterogeneous Wind Power Fleets: Global Temporal Fusion Transformer Leveraging Static Covariates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is critical for grid stability and electricity trading. While transformer-based deep learning is state of the art, industry practice reli

Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is critical for grid stability and electricity trading. While transformer-based deep learning is state of the art, industry practice relies mostly on local models trained for individual assets. This study investigates whether a global temporal fusion transformer (TFT), trained jointly on a heterogeneous portfolio of wind farms across Germany, outperforms site-specific local models in 48-hour-ahead forecasting. Using numerical weather prediction (NWP) data from the regional ICON-D2 and the global ECMWF HRES models, we compare the global TFT against local models and a linear regression baseline. The global model leverages static covariates, such as farm age, altitude above sea level, hub height, rotor diameter and power curve parameters, to learn shared representations across sites. We evaluate on 100 synthetic wind farm profiles and a real portfolio of 11 German wind farms, across two seasonal test periods with intermediate retraining. The global TFT outperforms the local models for 87% of the synthetic and 77% of the real wind farms and clearly surpasses the linear baseline. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm that these gains are significa…

item.title: Separation Is a Riesz Energy: How Many Environments Does ICA Need?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the nu

Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the number of components $d$ grows? We answer both for the joint diagonalization of $K$ covariances. Each component has a signature, its variances across the environments. Separating component $j$ costs the Riesz 2-energy $E_j$ of this signature, a sum, over the other components, of inverse pairwise Fisher informations. For Gaussian sources no estimator in $O(d)$ beats $cE_j/(n+E_j)$ at any $n$ and $d$, and above an explicit sample size a spectral estimator attains $E_j/n$ up to a constant, for every mixing and without the signatures (given a lower bound on the pairwise information). Since signatures live in $K-1$ dimensions, the rate obeys a dimension law: $d^2/n$, $d\log d/n$ and $d/n$ for $K=2$, $3$ and $K\ge4$ well-spread environments. What counts is the dimension the signatures span, not their number, and $\log d$ well-designed environments make $d\log d$ samples suffice. Projecting the covariances onto one linear combination pays $d^2/n$ at first order instead. In simulations up to $d=1000$ the prediction…

item.title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defe

Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on Agen…

item.title: RoadBlock: Rethinking GPU Tensor Core Microarchitecture for Emerging Microscaling Format Support
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：自定义 Microscaling（MX）格式的硬件评估局限于独立 MAC 单元原型，忽略真实 GPU Tensor Core 内的系统级集成开销——如何在流片前端到端评估？

方法：RoadBlock，基于 RISC-V Vortex GPGPU 的开源框架，在可编程 Tensor Core 中精确建模自定义 MX 格式；数据大小、scale-factor 大小与 block 大小均为可配置参数，自动为任意格式推导 per-thread 元数据 tiling。

关键数字：原文为框架与方法描述，未给出量化性能数字。

为什么值得看：可在投入硅片前评估格式特定的 Perplexity-PPA 权衡，芯片/硬件评估团队直接可用。

item.title: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic a

RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $κ$, together with an effective counterpart $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce reward budgeting, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. For binary rewards and independent on-policy rollouts, its unclipped score-function estimator follows the gradient of an exact finite-$G$ concave objective with diminishing returns, while its advantage gap decreases as more rollouts become correct. For general rewards, a shifted log-mean interpretation holds asymptotically under the stated regularity conditions. These results motivate, rather than establish exact objective equivalence for, the clipped implementations. On Qwen3-8B and Llama3…

item.title: Phantom: Temporal Caching for Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：扩散模型是高质量图像生成的主流范式，但跨数十时间步的迭代推理计算开销大；既有加速器靠差分量化或输出稀疏性，却带来内存足迹增加、设计复杂与图像退化——能否用时间缓存干净地加速？

方法：提出 Phantom 算法-架构协同设计：把时间相似性看作差分稀疏性，相邻时间步间只有少量异常 token 显著变化；Phantom 只重算这些异常 token，其余从时间缓存复用；在全局缓冲加轻量 Phantom Engine 检测异常并更新缓存，用浓缩流水线把稀疏更新映射到稠密脉动计算。

关键数字：在主流扩散模型上平均 4.0x 加速、5.5x 能耗节省（相对 GPU 与既有加速器），生成质量保持不变。

为什么值得看：用标准脉动阵列 + 轻量附加即可兑现时间冗余，是扩散推理加速里少见的保质量方案。

原文：Phantom: Temporal Caching for Diffusion Models
